programme.title: 為食家族
programme.desc: 在兩日一夜的 Staycation 中，難得有戶外郊遊的機會，燒烤當然是一個非常必然的活動，不過各家族在享受有的趣燒烤過程中會繼續接受考驗，到底哪一隊才是真正的燒烤高手？而在 Staycation 當晚，老、中、青三代分組與主持及管家進行情深對話分享，三代人分別流露了對親人的關愛及感激之情，令到主持肥仔有感而發，流下男兒淚.

programme.title: 山旮旯拯救隊
programme.desc: 本次山旯旮拯救隊Dixon跟王鋒來到了南台灣的高雄，要去尋找一位為高雄美濃推動地方創生的青年陳佳鴻，他除了推動美濃當地的地方創生，也時常舉辦市集來連結各地的地方創生團隊一起推廣地方特色產品，主持人第一站就來到高雄美術館前的地方創生市集，在陳佳鴻的介紹下認識來自台灣各地的創生品牌團隊，也親手體驗製作地方特產愛玉，了解到地方創生不只能在當地發展，也可以藉由各種方式推廣到不同縣市去.

programme.title: 癮營人
programme.desc: 舍監嘉盈、許賢和管家Thomas，扮演各位癮營人，並虛構一些情節，例如Polly對住父母很率性，Emily肉緊男友皮膚，Creamy限住孩子食飯時間，STEM Sir理性分析電影，遭朋友制止等等，當事人都很有共鳴。三人落力演出，癮營人則化身secret angel，偷影指定對象，他們所拍的照片，全部和對方的癮無關，可見要真正了解人，得放下成見，彼此接納、尊重，當人活在當下，心癮亦不藥而癒.

programme.title: 放學玩啲咩
programme.desc: 鍾意運動的朋友仔一定有看過體操比賽，原來體操起源於2000幾年前的古希臘。因為練習體操是需要好強的身體素質以及技巧，所以不似一般的運動這麼流行.

programme.title: 第44屆香港電影金像奬紅地氈盛況
CHILL CLUB 推介榜
programme.desc: 「CHILL CLUB 推介榜」，與樂迷公佈本週第一至十位推介歌曲.

programme.title: 週六好戲勢: 蠟筆小新劇場版: 吶喊吧！春日部野生王國
programme.desc: 新當選的里長四膳守熱心環保工作，甚至到小新的幼稚園去做宣導，還帶小新與朋友們去外面幫忙撿垃圾。小新在河邊撿到了一瓶來路不明的飲料，卻意外被爸爸和媽媽喝掉了，結果爸爸和媽媽變成了動物！原來這都是四膳守的陰謀！為了拯救爸爸和媽媽，小新決心對抗到底.

programme.title: 狗仔隊亂入Seoul
programme.desc: 一山市有間元祖級狗狗幼稚園，曾因一張替狗狗鋪床午睡的照片爆紅，Kathy和Dixon決定拜訪其校長，認識韓國獨有的狗狗託管文化。二人意外地獲得狗狗們的喜愛，一度陷入混亂.

programme.title: 蹦蹦地球遊戲室
programme.desc: 為抓捕逃往地球的月球兔子而聚集在一起的4名勇士穿越時空展開的新概念混合元宇宙動作冒險綜藝節目.

programme.title: 貓之旅神
programme.desc: 第四集兩位《貓之旅神》的Location轉移到了京都！貓咪天性就是為食，Shirley跟Asha都不例外，第一時間來到人氣Donut店，享用要排長龍才買到的好味Donut！為了令Asha用最好的方式遊覧京都，好姐妹Shirley除了帶Asha Shopping、住靚嘅日本酒店之外，更準備了豪華直昇機體驗！玩飽食醉二人就來到今集最讓人期待的行程--出發貓島！但旅程卻意料之外地向著讓人震驚，摸不著頭腦的方向展開！.

programme.title: 山旮旯拯救隊
programme.desc: 本次山旯旮拯救隊Dixon跟王鋒來到了南台灣的高雄，要去尋找一位為高雄美濃推動地方創生的青年陳佳鴻，他除了推動美濃當地的地方創生，也時常舉辦市集來連結各地的地方創生團隊一起推廣地方特色產品，主持人第一站就來到高雄美術館前的地方創生市集，在陳佳鴻的介紹下認識來自台灣各地的創生品牌團隊，也親手體驗製作地方特產愛玉，了解到地方創生不只能在當地發展，也可以藉由各種方式推廣到不同縣市去.

programme.title: 環源基本步
programme.sub-title: 社區中被忽視的種子變成音樂表演的一部分
programme.desc: 丁丁和雅錡兩位90後的環保創作人，將大眾認為無用的廢物轉化為獨特的樂器和飾物。三年前，因一件種子樂器而受到啟發，開始尋找城市中被遺忘的資源。從社區中收集干果核，經過清洗、設計和創作，變成引人注目的藝術作品。倡導人們重新認識和珍惜身邊的自然資源，品牌象徵與自然的深厚連結，並鼓勵大家發掘身邊的美好與可能.

programme.title: 聲的築城者
programme.desc: 《聲的築城者》是⼀個以香港為舞台的⽂化紀錄節⽬，透過鏡頭走訪⾳樂產業的不同⾓落，尋找那些推動香港⾳樂⽂化發展的靈魂⼈物。從舞台上光芒四射的歌⼿，到幕後默默耕耘的作曲家、填詞⼈、編曲⼈、監製，再到塑造市場與⾳樂⽅向的唱⽚公司，以及承載無數回憶的現場⾳樂表演場地──節⽬將全⾯呈現香港⾳樂⽣態背後的⼒量與故事.

programme.title: 中佬唔易做
programme.desc: 嘉年做外賣速遞員，因在送餐時被客人發現他在偷拍而聲稱報警，最後他如何拆解誤會？而首天工作中遇到手機沒電，原來尋找手機充電對他來說都是一項挑戰，他會如何解決？而任職家品部售貨員的古明華低估了售貨員的工作，整天都未能記熟產品的資料，如在夢中，加上遇到麻煩客人的諸多要求，他又能否獨自應付.

programme.title: 雙線運動人生
programme.desc: 劉雪汶 Sherman，中學時期因體育堂被老師發掘，從零開始自學苦練壘球運動，一路從校隊打到香港代表隊。她2025年赴台灣效力高雄新世紀黃蜂女子快壘隊，成為首位在台灣企業聯賽出賽的香港球員。憑著堅韌意志，在資源有限的香港壘球環境中不斷突破，展現「港女壘」的拼搏精神.

programme.title: 設計新態度
programme.desc: 設計學院作為設計師的搖籃，投入了什麼資源孕育設計新血？今集主持訪問設計學院的院長，並參觀展覽，了解學院的教學方針.

programme.title: 菁新力量
programme.desc: 身兼樂器設計師與聲音藝術家的吳澤霖，去年成功研發出全港首對電子踢躂舞鞋。他最擅長從日常生活看似紛亂的聲音節奏中，尋找並建立屬於自己的藝術秩序。今集主持將到其工作室，探索這對鞋及其他作品背後的故事.

programme.title: 瑪嘉烈與大衛系列 絲絲
programme.desc: 大文號的租約即將期滿，但似乎每個人對大文號的去向都有不同心思。是結束還是繼續，都不是那麼容易決定的事，Diamond隱約覺得自己原本回來對新生活的期盼都一一落空，大衛卻不想就此結束一切。瑪嘉烈的舊同事Derek從英國回到香港探望她，此刻香港的感情、關係都令她萌生離開的想法，但即將行動之際，烈火卻一改以往態度令她無所適從。四人交纏的關係，當中的絲線似乎並不能輕易解開⋯⋯.

programme.desc: 清澈的海底裡，魚群穿過珊瑚，感覺優哉。港人夫婦Lydia和Leo在陽光普照的綠島經營潛店 TID (Therefore I dive)，Lydia是潛水教練，Leo負責預約接待等後勤工作。Lydia與台灣拍檔阿蓉的處事方式不同，不滿阿蓉寬容對待不聽指示的潛水客，過於跟他們打成一片；Leo充當緩和二人矛盾的角色。在台北，看起來像獨遊旅客的Yvonne 在溫泉旅館好好享受，用餐時碰上好奇愛聊天的侍應打探她的外地人身分，她以一個謊言終結這段尷尬的對話。回到家裡，Yvonne發覺久未更新的部落格竟然有人留言，留言來自一位欣賞她畫作的部落客。在台北的另一處，穿著清秀的Faye首次參加單身聯誼，活動中遇到一位久未脫單的男生阿峰。在聯誼尾聲，Faye沒有作出任何選擇，峰卻主動追上與Faye交換聯絡.

programme.title: 家務神隊友
programme.desc: 今集神隊友家訪雨橋同細佬，呢一對情侶成日都拍片放閃，佢哋屋企浴室嘅溫泉浴缸仲係KOL界嘅傳說聖地！今集兩位神隊友一場嚟到當然要試吓個浴缸……意思係試吓清潔個浴缸啊.

programme.title: 動物守衛隊
programme.desc: 香港人工作繁忙，大部分公司都不能攜帶寵物上班，主人只能把寵物獨留在家中。而香港有一項新興的寵物服務是「狗狗日托」，他們專門協助主人在日間時間照顧狗狗，讓狗狗在日間時間有人陪伴之餘，更不用因獨自在家而產生不必要的意外。今集兩位主持會成為一日狗狗日托照顧員，她們能夠同時控制多隻狗狗嗎.

programme.title: 演奏1 TAKE過
programme.desc: 秉承《1 TAKE 過》節目宗旨，相信玩音樂嘅人用無數光陰去苦練一種樂器，背後都會有一個屬於佢哋嘅故事，希望令每一個觀眾都欣賞自己最自豪、最自信、最厲害嘅一面。新一季節目《演奏 1 TAKE 過》，今次挑選出10個不同故事背景又好值得大家睇到嘅演奏單位，畀一次機會佢哋上台表演，甚至不同樂器大玩Crossover表演.

programme.title: P1X3L 5G 上位計劃
programme.desc: 又到年末，年輕人最愛開派對，當然包括P1X3L 5G。派對一定要有人、食物和禮物﹗本集邀得神秘嘉賓作客P1X3L 5G年末派對﹗8位主持「捐窿捐罅」，有人要到昂坪買豆花，或者要到塔門買炸墨丸，最甚更要坐船過大海買杏仁餅，目的就是要買齊派對食物宴請嘉賓﹗。節目組更豪派過萬元禮物，令主持和嘉賓快樂過肥年.

programme.title: 貓之旅神
programme.desc: 在美麗神秘、歷史悠久的京都，遇到了神明的兩位《 貓之旅神》，彷彿穿越時空般感受到了古代日本人的生活氣息，她們更跟足神明指示，用傳統方式參拜了神社。除了保佑自身平安，Shirley跟Asha更來到了網上極人氣的動物寺廟，與貓住寺互動並掃了一籃子的動物御守！接著二人搭著嵯峨野列車來到了嵐山，感受嵐山迷人的風光以及拜訪景色媲美琉璃光院，最適合女孩子打咭拍美照與大自然融為一體的美麗亭院.

programme.title: 不一樣的爸媽
programme.desc: 視障人士的世界一定是灰黑色嗎？其實對於部分視障朋友來說，即使有不可抗逆的疾病，只要保持正面心態，他們的世界仍然充滿色彩。這個家庭亦正在學習與兒子的眼疾相處，媽媽以過往任職眼科護士的經驗，為患有先天性青光眼的兒子好好適應生活，並為他日後隨時失明作好準備.

programme.title: 馬泰有FOOD了 -馬來西亞萬里望花生
programme.desc: 想不到吃一粒花生原來背後需要付出眾多人的勞力，而且毫不顯眼的它更可以烹調出不同的美食。今集去到怡保找尋最出名的萬里望花生，不只單單去「望」花生，兩位主持更會親手將每粒花生分類，親手做花生糖，體驗工人「粒粒皆辛苦」的辛酸.

programme.title: MM730 - 困獸鬥
programme.sub-title: 肥仔及 Isabella 2人組對其餘4人組
programme.desc: 今集肥仔和Isabella2人組隊對程人富，洪嘉豪，米露迪和WinWin，人數上2人隊當然較輸蝕，但有肥仔這位遊戲之王上陣，似乎可以看高一線，他們分別玩2個遊戲，第1個攻防戰，防守隊喺指定範圍內任企位置，攻擊隊要矇眼聽指令，最多只可以俾5個指令，成功打到防守隊就可以得分。第2個遊戲在2隊要在限時之內將牌翻到自己隊的一面，翻到最多牌為之勝出。到底今集大贏家是誰.

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 《大鳴大放》是一個30分鐘的時事討論節目，識英雄重英雄，請來各界重磅名人，拋出論點，言無不盡，深入討論時事，跨越維港神州，宏觀全世界.

programme.title: 本周快閃人口
programme.sub-title: 日本快閃婚攝：神戶終章
programme.desc: 《本周快閃人口》日本快閃婚攝三集企劃，喺第十三集迎接尾聲。Ranya 同婚禮攝影師 Zero 一齊去咗神戶睇景，順便當作旅行般探索城市。佢哋先去異人館感受異國風情，再到生田神社散步於周邊街道，感受神戶特有嘅浪漫氛圍。其後仲去咗一所日本婚宴場地，睇睇本地人結婚、擺酒嘅地方同流程，一邊想像婚攝同場地之間嘅配合。旅程尾聲，兩人登上欣賞神戶百萬夜景嘅觀景點，喺燈火映照下回望呢段快閃婚攝旅程，為整個日本系列留下一個溫暖而難忘嘅結尾.

programme.title: 寶礦力水特電解質水 ion water 呈獻: 週六好戲勢: 怪物
製作中 -IT狗職員真面目大公開 上
怪獸8號
programme.desc: 在防衛隊入隊儀式上沒看見卡夫卡的身影，琪歌露露出了失落的神情。就在這時遲到的卡夫卡出現了。雖然沒能通過測驗，但他在第3部隊副隊長．保科的推薦下成為了防衛隊的候補隊員。伴夥們因卡夫卡的加入而元氣大增。但保科心裡卻有著其他想法.

programme.title: 分手100次
programme.desc: 阿森（鄭伊健 飾）和小嵐（周秀娜 飾）相戀8年，而他們用以維繫感情的方法只得兩個字——分手。每當小嵐以分手作要脅時，阿森都會變成一條死狗去求和，令小嵐更加得寸進尺。當他們經歷了99次分手後，二人終於認定了彼此，因而許下不能再輕易分手的承諾，更決意要一起為未來打拼，自己當老闆，合力經營咖啡店。一眾豬朋狗友如茶餐廳太子女瑞哥（王菀之 飾）、阿森的小學同學飛雲（何浩鵬 飾）及咖啡店員4大Boy （C All Star 飾）等人不但見證著咖啡店的成長，同時亦目擊營運咖啡店對阿森和小嵐這對小情侶所造成的衝擊。尤其是當本來平平無奇的咖啡店因著阿森天馬行空的鬼主意——《分手迷你倉》，一個可以讓所有愛情暴露狂來寄存自己的分手遺物，好讓全世界來偷窺的地方——而大受歡迎後，阿森變得不再只以玩樂為先，開始變得成熟，對未來也更有想法。咖啡店的成功令阿森跟小嵐之間的距離愈拉愈遠，這時候咖啡店的熟客萊萊（溫心 飾）跟阿森的關係又變得曖昧不清，這一切彷佛都在引爆他們的第100次分手.

programme.title: 勁騎26
programme.desc: 「香港真係一個好靚嘅地方」講就成日講，但又有幾多人真係熟悉香港嘅地方？有人鍾意揸住電單車周圍去打卡、有人揸電單車為咗送外賣搵食，但有人揸電單車為咗用更近嘅距離去感受香港嘅每寸土地。今集 Alton 將會感受用另一個角度睇呢片土地.

programme.title: 文藝誌
programme.desc: 百年唐樓內的水墨藝術，如何與歷史相映成趣？今集主持訪問水墨畫家，聽聽她創作藝術畫作的故事.

programme.title: 菁新力量
programme.desc: 冠軍咖啡師歐祖華（Gary）為了追求完美口感，不只飛往世界各地尋找優質咖啡豆，還設計「一杯兩味」的咖啡杯。今集主持將走進他的咖啡世界，細談建立咖啡品牌前後的挑戰，並即場偷師，學習沖調技巧.

programme.title: 環源基本步
programme.sub-title: 用地盤廢土製成的陶瓷作品
programme.desc: 設計師 Niko利用香港土壤，將廢棄物料轉化為陶瓷及夯土建材。收集廢料、清洗、處理和重塑，讓這些材料重新煥發生命。透過工作坊與藝術裝置，讓市民認識土壤的價值。升級再造後的成品，象徵著環保與可持續發展的理念，讓社會重新思考與土地之間的關係。促進市民對本地資源的珍惜與保護，擁抱創新的循環再造.

programme.title: 中佬唔易做
programme.desc: 經歷了在陌生的港島區外賣速遞工作的嘉年，今天他會改到較熟路的九龍區接單，希望可以減短揾路的時間。可惜天公不造美，工作日整天下雨，大大增加送單時的困難，到底嘉年能否準時把外賣送到客人手中？而今天轉到傢俬部工作的古明華，要重新適應新環境和學習新技能，對於自問不夠細心的他，到底能否勝任這項新挑戰.

programme.title: 老友記實用手冊
programme.desc: 生老病死乃必經之路，年華老去亦絕非千瘡百孔，「老」並不代表老態龍鍾，而是歲月每個階段中所帶來的智慧美感。重中之重是如何優雅地老去，不受年齡束縛，散發出專屬自己的魅力。本節目將為觀眾探索本地專為老友記設計的設施和服務，旨在幫助觀眾了解如何在日常生活中照顧自己與家人。廠景將邀請不同的專家及嘉賓，深入剖析如何面對老年生活的各種挑戰，包括健康管理、社交活動及心理支持；同時滲透社區內老人支援服務及生活設施的外景介紹，讓觀眾體驗如何在熟悉的城市中找到適合長者的生活方式.

programme.title: 雙線運動人生
programme.desc: 劉展豪，前香港龍舟代表隊成員兼運動教練。近年他積極推廣龍舟加體能的訓練文化，亦帶領年輕運動員備戰本地及國際賽事。用專業與熱情推廣香港龍舟運動，體現「水上拼搏」的香港精神.

台灣係咁駕
programme.desc: 雖然天氣不似預期，但下雨天最適合「耍廢」了！誰說旅行一定要塞滿行程？今天放慢步調，在雨中尋找最「廢」的行程。早上起床吃個靚 Brunch，飲杯靚珍奶，去個靚廢墟，再食個靚宵夜。就算下雨天也不能影響旅行該有的靚心情.

programme.desc: 《聲的築城者》是⼀個以香港為舞台的⽂化紀錄節⽬，透過鏡頭走訪⾳樂產業的不同⾓落，尋找那些推動香港⾳樂⽂化發展的靈魂⼈物。從舞台上光芒四射的歌⼿，到幕後默默耕耘的作曲家、填詞⼈、編曲⼈、監製，再到塑造市場與⾳樂⽅向的唱⽚公司，以及承載無數回憶的現場⾳樂表演場地──節⽬將全⾯呈現香港⾳樂⽣態背後的⼒量與故事.

programme.title: 深宵更 -滅蟲
programme.desc: 節目組今鋪大整蠱！珈其生日當日竟然被安排到滅蟲公司當實習生，甫上班便要深入曱甴、老鼠大本營設置藥餌和陷阱。不過這個工序只算是小兒科，最驚心動魄的莫過於驗收時間，珈其更被主管委以重任做先頭部隊….

programme.title: 為食家族
programme.sub-title: 美食一百 勁飲勁食
programme.desc: Staycation 最後一擊，考驗各家族五感的敏感程度！到底單從五感中，各家族對美食的了解會有幾深？輕鬆過後又再來到殘忍的淘汰賽，作為為食家族當然要食得，兼且要食得多！今集製作組搜羅全港一百款美食，各家族在限時內食得最多便可以繼續晉級。到底三隊家族中哪一隊才是真正的大胃王，免被淘汰.

programme.title: 山旮旯拯救隊
programme.desc: 山旯旮拯救隊的Dixon跟王鋒來到了美濃菸仕物所尋找陳佳鴻，陳佳鴻也介紹了當地的創生夥伴帶兩位主持參觀他們地方創生中老宅改建的成果「美濃菸仕物所」，接著陳佳鴻帶著兩位主持人去參觀美濃當地賴以為生的水圳，更深入的認識美濃當地文化特色，最後去認識當地一起合作地方創生的商家夥伴，讓兩位感受到地方創生為地方帶來的活力及經濟發展.

programme.title: 腦霧研究所
programme.desc: 為咗挑戰人類大腦潛能，腦霧研究所派出咗人類精英代表Shirley，Yoshi同Kenji 一齊嚟到香港唔同嘅特色場地，向各個達人偷師，挑戰其工作內容！而第一集就嚟到米線餐廳，眾所周知，香港茶餐廳堪稱世界上數一數二最多選擇同配搭，侍應們能夠快狠準咁成功落單真係好考腦力！連侍應聽到都怕怕嘅地獄級數挑戰，屋企嘅觀眾都可以試吓一齊玩！唔知三位主持又應唔應付到，邊一個會成為今集腦霧王呢.

programme.title: 巴絲Let’s go歐
programme.sub-title: 蒲吧遊戲大挑戰，考驗Ranya Leanne姊妹情
programme.desc: 英國之旅第二站，李敏(Ranya)同細妹李賢(Leanne)勇闖野生動物園餵動物，仲有機動遊戲玩到Leanne發出嬌喘？夜晚兩姊妹蒲吧，以運動項目大戰製作組，輸咗嘅一方將會受到屈辱性嘅懲罰！酒吧內眾多玩意，激發二人嘅鬥心同少女心，仲透露更多關於對方嘅秘密.

programme.title: 我哋都係香港人
programme.desc: 新德莉莉作為一個土生土長的印度人，生活習慣都已經很地道，就是因為拍攝YouTube之後，慢慢就了解到自己印度的文化。閒時仲會去學校與一些同學分享，身為少數族裔在香港成長的點滴，仲會分享很多經驗給一些在校的少數族裔添.

programme.title: 放學玩啲咩
programme.desc: 經常在電影裡面看到演員跳踢躂舞，只要動一動跳一跳就會發出好有節奏的聲音，同一般我們見到的舞蹈很不同。究竟踢躂舞是一種甚麼樣的舞蹈，而踢躂舞又是在何時開始呢.

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 《大鳴大放》是一個30分鐘的時事討論節目，識英雄重英雄，請來各界重磅名人，拋出論點，言無不盡，深入討論時事，跨越維港神州，宏觀全世界.

programme.title: 經緯線
programme.desc: 專題式深入報道香港及世界熱門時事.

programme.title: 別在蒙古矇查查
programme.desc: 蒙古國，位於東亞內陸，面積156萬平方公里，是世界上人口密度最低的國家之⼀，約340萬人 （截至2025年估計）散居於此。這個國家以成吉思汗創建的蒙古帝國聞名是獨立⺠主國家，⾸都烏蘭巴托聚集近⼀半人口，經濟依賴礦業與畜牧業。 然而，外界對它的認知卻充滿誤解，常被認為荒涼沙漠、落後遊牧或單⼀文化的刻板形象。本集節⽬將直面這些偏⾒，通過10個迷思揭示蒙古國的真實面貌，從自然景觀到現代生活，帶觀眾新認識這個被低估的國度.

programme.title: 我想身體健康
programme.desc: 一次頭痛、流鼻水、咳嗽，看似是小病，其實可能屬於某一種嚴重疾病的先兆! 大家應好好認識不同病症，以防患於未然，或及時對症下藥! 本節目將搜羅各醫科常見的都市病，或奇難雜症，觀眾難於啟齒的身體問題.

programme.title: FWD 富衛保險呈獻: CHILL CLUB
programme.sub-title: 嘉賓: Anson Lo 盧瀚霆
programme.desc: 本集邀請 Anson Lo 盧瀚霆 擔任嘉賓，以「A.L.」為主題，A.L. 不只是名字的縮寫，更是一段由冒險出發、突破界限，最終走向完整自我的音樂旅程。同時，本集亦邀請 Mischa 葉巧琳 帶來新歌《不是那種勵志歌》，展現她細膩而真摯的音樂風格。另外，「CHILL CLUB 推介榜」會同樂迷一齊公布本週十大推介歌曲.

programme.title: 人類觀察學
programme.desc: “如果我是XX，你會怎麼做？”《人類觀察學》是一個有關率直反應概念題材的節目，它採訪了大街上的素人以及名人，並利用隱藏攝像頭捕捉被觀察者的反應。例如，如果一個受歡迎的名人打扮成普通的店員會怎樣呢？或者當一個略為微醉的丈夫決定問妻子是否愛他時，會發生什麼事情？她的反應會是什麼？她又會否作出回應？在這個節目裡，人們的坦率反應屢屢超乎想像.

programme.title: 製作中 -IT狗職員真面目大公開 下
週六好戲勢: 蠟筆小新劇場版：戰國大合戰
programme.desc: 某個晚上，野原一家同時夢見了一名身穿古裝衣服的「古代美女」。雖然全家人都覺得很奇怪，但並沒有再深入研究。有一天，小新從幼稚園回來時，看見正在庭院裡拼命地挖洞的小白挖出了一個箱子，內裡放著一封小新親筆寫的信。正當他在沉思之際，不知不覺來到了戰國時代。小新陰差陽錯下救了一名武士，更遇見那晚出現在夢裡的春日城城主的女兒。因為小新失蹤而心急如焚的廣志和美冴，發現了小新親筆寫的那封信後，決定到戰國時代尋找小新….

programme.title: Billion x School
programme.desc: 日本最大的財閥集團「加賀美集團」的CEO，也是一位天才發明家，加賀美零隱藏自己的身份，潛入私立絵都學園，成為了一名高中教師。該校的3年0班是一個集合了被認為「無幹勁、無才能、無前途」的學生，被學校其他部分貶低為「零組」。加賀美零將在這樣的環境中，與這些學生共同成長，挑戰教育常規.

programme.title: 醫師阿修羅
programme.desc: 女急救醫生杏野朱羅(松本若菜)有著出色的醫療技術，甚至能夠同時為兩名重症患者進行高難度手術，以致被稱為「阿修羅醫生」，她從不考慮醫院的利益，亦不會顧忌上級，只會專注拯救眼前的患者，即使對方身無分文又或者是黑道成員，都堅信要絕對幫助他們.

programme.title: 一點點超能力
programme.desc: 文太（大泉洋）是一名被公司解雇的落魄上班族。在和妻子離婚後，因財產分割與賠償金而耗盡積蓄，只能過著寄宿在網咖的生活。就在某一天，文太奇蹟地通過了一家公司的最終面試。在文太前往公司提前準備好的住宅時，一位陌生女子突然出現在家中並對他說「歡迎回來」。這似乎是必須以「夫妻」的身分和這個「陌生的妻子」一起生活。文太瞬間成為有「一點點超能力」的英雄，被賦予的任務是——「拯救世界」。然而，還附帶了一條不合理又難以理解的規則：「不可以真心地去愛任何人」.

programme.desc: 故事取材自 1984 年的真實經歷，當時三谷寫了一部喜劇小品劇本，準備在澀谷一家脫衣舞劇院的脫衣舞表演間隙表演，以分散來檢查的警察的注意力.

programme.title: 天空城堡
programme.desc: 只有最頂層的0.1%人口可住在天空城堡——一個獨特的住宅社區。在上流社會的「SKY Castle」中更住著一群欲扶助丈夫事業和培育子女成為二代貴族的貴婦。然而，這些貴婦都有一個秘密不能告訴任何人。她們的財富、榮譽和最重要的權力鬥爭從現在開始.

programme.desc: 文太（大泉洋）是一名被公司解雇的落魄上班族。在和妻子離婚後，因財產分割與賠償金而耗盡積蓄，只能過著寄宿在網咖的生活。就在某一天，文太奇蹟地通過了一家公司的最終面試。在文太前往公司提前準備好的住宅時，一位陌生女子突然出現在家中並對他說「歡迎回來」。這似乎是必須以「夫妻」的身分和這個「陌生的妻子」一起生活。文太瞬間成為有「一點點超能力」的英雄，被賦予的任務是——「拯救世界」。然而，還附帶了一條不合理又難以理解的規則：「不可以真心地去愛任何人」.

programme.title: 7人的逃脫
programme.desc: 劇情講述一個少女的失蹤交織著無數的謊言和慾望，牽涉其中的七個人遭遇重大事件後發生的故事。這七個人都會為了個人私慾背叛，出賣他人，過著充滿謊言的生活。​.

programme.title: Love Me
programme.desc: 講述婦產科醫生雖然看起來擁有財富、名譽和外貌，卻是一個孤獨至極的人物。她從崩潰的家庭中逃離出來，某天遇到了唯一能夠看穿她的孤獨的男人，重新找回家庭關係並成長的故事.

programme.title: 月亮在江邊流淌
programme.desc: 講述失去笑容的朝鮮王世子，擁有冷峻氣質與壓倒性的氣場，背負着喪失摯愛與朝廷鬥爭的傷痛。以及樂觀開朗的女攤販，雖然失去部分過去記憶，仍堅強面對生活。在某日二人意外靈魂互換，進而展開對自身與他人命運的重新審視，並因靈魂互換而展開浪漫奇幻愛情故事.

programme.title: 有利的詐欺
programme.desc: 講述兩名截然不同的人 ─ 缺乏同情心的騙子與同情心氾濫的律師因與邪惡抗爭，組成了一支看起來不太可能實現的聯盟後所發生的故事.

programme.title: 奇蹟的兄弟
programme.desc: 講述一位懷抱著成為名作家夢想的志願生，雖然父親期望他成為像「尹東柱」這樣的劃時代詩人而取名，但現實是只有一身債務的作家志願生陸東柱，和來歷不明、有著特殊能力的少年姜山超越時間的界限一起尋找真相並創造奇蹟的過程.

programme.desc: 劇情講述一個少女的失蹤交織著無數的謊言和慾望，牽涉其中的七個人遭遇重大事件後發生的故事。這七個人都會為了個人私慾背叛，出賣他人，過著充滿謊言的生活。​.

programme.title: Love Me
programme.desc: 講述婦產科醫生雖然看起來擁有財富、名譽和外貌，卻是一個孤獨至極的人物。她從崩潰的家庭中逃離出來，某天遇到了唯一能夠看穿她的孤獨的男人，重新找回家庭關係並成長的故事.

programme.title: 月亮在江邊流淌
programme.desc: 講述失去笑容的朝鮮王世子，擁有冷峻氣質與壓倒性的氣場，背負着喪失摯愛與朝廷鬥爭的傷痛。以及樂觀開朗的女攤販，雖然失去部分過去記憶，仍堅強面對生活。在某日二人意外靈魂互換，進而展開對自身與他人命運的重新審視，並因靈魂互換而展開浪漫奇幻愛情故事.

programme.title: 有利的詐欺
programme.desc: 講述兩名截然不同的人 ─ 缺乏同情心的騙子與同情心氾濫的律師因與邪惡抗爭，組成了一支看起來不太可能實現的聯盟後所發生的故事.

programme.desc: 講述失去笑容的朝鮮王世子，擁有冷峻氣質與壓倒性的氣場，背負着喪失摯愛與朝廷鬥爭的傷痛。以及樂觀開朗的女攤販，雖然失去部分過去記憶，仍堅強面對生活。在某日二人意外靈魂互換，進而展開對自身與他人命運的重新審視，並因靈魂互換而展開浪漫奇幻愛情故事.

programme.title: 有利的詐欺
programme.desc: 講述兩名截然不同的人 ─ 缺乏同情心的騙子與同情心氾濫的律師因與邪惡抗爭，組成了一支看起來不太可能實現的聯盟後所發生的故事.

programme.title: 奇蹟的兄弟
programme.desc: 講述一位懷抱著成為名作家夢想的志願生，雖然父親期望他成為像「尹東柱」這樣的劃時代詩人而取名，但現實是只有一身債務的作家志願生陸東柱，和來歷不明、有著特殊能力的少年姜山超越時間的界限一起尋找真相並創造奇蹟的過程.

programme.title: 7人的逃脫
programme.desc: 劇情講述一個少女的失蹤交織著無數的謊言和慾望，牽涉其中的七個人遭遇重大事件後發生的故事。這七個人都會為了個人私慾背叛，出賣他人，過著充滿謊言的生活。​.

programme.title: 醫師阿修羅
programme.desc: 女急救醫生杏野朱羅(松本若菜)有著出色的醫療技術，甚至能夠同時為兩名重症患者進行高難度手術，以致被稱為「阿修羅醫生」，她從不考慮醫院的利益，亦不會顧忌上級，只會專注拯救眼前的患者，即使對方身無分文又或者是黑道成員，都堅信要絕對幫助他們.

programme.title: 一點點超能力
programme.desc: 文太（大泉洋）是一名被公司解雇的落魄上班族。在和妻子離婚後，因財產分割與賠償金而耗盡積蓄，只能過著寄宿在網咖的生活。就在某一天，文太奇蹟地通過了一家公司的最終面試。在文太前往公司提前準備好的住宅時，一位陌生女子突然出現在家中並對他說「歡迎回來」。這似乎是必須以「夫妻」的身分和這個「陌生的妻子」一起生活。文太瞬間成為有「一點點超能力」的英雄，被賦予的任務是——「拯救世界」。然而，還附帶了一條不合理又難以理解的規則：「不可以真心地去愛任何人」.

programme.title: Billion x School
programme.desc: 日本最大的財閥集團「加賀美集團」的CEO，也是一位天才發明家，加賀美零隱藏自己的身份，潛入私立絵都學園，成為了一名高中教師。該校的3年0班是一個集合了被認為「無幹勁、無才能、無前途」的學生，被學校其他部分貶低為「零組」。加賀美零將在這樣的環境中，與這些學生共同成長，挑戰教育常規.

programme.desc: 女急救醫生杏野朱羅(松本若菜)有著出色的醫療技術，甚至能夠同時為兩名重症患者進行高難度手術，以致被稱為「阿修羅醫生」，她從不考慮醫院的利益，亦不會顧忌上級，只會專注拯救眼前的患者，即使對方身無分文又或者是黑道成員，都堅信要絕對幫助他們.

programme.title: 一點點超能力
programme.desc: 文太（大泉洋）是一名被公司解雇的落魄上班族。在和妻子離婚後，因財產分割與賠償金而耗盡積蓄，只能過著寄宿在網咖的生活。就在某一天，文太奇蹟地通過了一家公司的最終面試。在文太前往公司提前準備好的住宅時，一位陌生女子突然出現在家中並對他說「歡迎回來」。這似乎是必須以「夫妻」的身分和這個「陌生的妻子」一起生活。文太瞬間成為有「一點點超能力」的英雄，被賦予的任務是——「拯救世界」。然而，還附帶了一條不合理又難以理解的規則：「不可以真心地去愛任何人」.

programme.title: Billion x School
programme.desc: 日本最大的財閥集團「加賀美集團」的CEO，也是一位天才發明家，加賀美零隱藏自己的身份，潛入私立絵都學園，成為了一名高中教師。該校的3年0班是一個集合了被認為「無幹勁、無才能、無前途」的學生，被學校其他部分貶低為「零組」。加賀美零將在這樣的環境中，與這些學生共同成長，挑戰教育常規.

programme.title: 如果這世界是舞台，那後台在哪裡
programme.desc: 故事取材自 1984 年的真實經歷，當時三谷寫了一部喜劇小品劇本，準備在澀谷一家脫衣舞劇院的脫衣舞表演間隙表演，以分散來檢查的警察的注意力.

programme.title: 米之女 ─國稅局資料調查課・雜國室─
programme.desc: 日本國稅局「米」課，是令逃稅者聞風喪膽的最終防線。在其內部，新設了一個原創部門——複雜國稅案件處理室「雜國室」。由米田正子（松嶋菜菜子 飾）領軍，集結一群身懷絕技的怪才，專門制裁最棘手難纏的惡德逃稅者，成為體系內獨特而強悍的制裁之刃.

programme.title: 天空城堡
programme.desc: 只有最頂層的0.1%人口可住在天空城堡——一個獨特的住宅社區。在上流社會的「SKY Castle」中更住著一群欲扶助丈夫事業和培育子女成為二代貴族的貴婦。然而，這些貴婦都有一個秘密不能告訴任何人。她們的財富、榮譽和最重要的權力鬥爭從現在開始.

programme.title: 顯微鏡下的大明之絲絹案
programme.desc: 痴迷於數學的帥家默偶然發現金華縣一個歷史遺留問題，他在試圖糾正錯誤的過程中頻頻遇阻，並引發了各利益集團間的博弈。 軍戶出身的帥家默對數學極其感興趣，在一次拿各縣賦稅練習數學時，偶然發現有一筆科目叫作“人丁絲絹”稅收數目有疑點。經過查詢，帥家默知道有人偷換概念、移花接木，把原本各縣的賦稅轉嫁給了一個縣。帥家默瞭解此事後決定申訴，但在申訴過程中遇到重重困難，險些喪命，“人丁絲絹案”就此擱淺。後遇改革，舊案重提，經過帥家默和各方努力才讓真相大白於天下.

programme.title: 唐朝詭事錄之長安
programme.desc: 先天二年夏秋之交，天子雖已登基，但大長公主勢力更盛，長安局勢陰晴難定。盧凌風和蘇無名，奉命帶著由裴喜君、費雞師、櫻桃和薛環組成的探案小隊，以護送康國所獻金桃的名義重返長安.

programme.title: 愛很美味
programme.desc: 《愛很美味》講述了三位個性迥異、特色鮮明的都市麗人，在經歷了一系列創業的艱辛，職場的壓迫，和感情的波折後，對生活、事業和愛情都有了重新的認識.

programme.title: 風與潮
programme.desc: 本劇講述二戰期間1942-1945年澳門「孤島」時期的抗戰風雲故事。 1941年12月香港淪陷後，澳葡政府名為“中立”，實則任由日軍澤榮作特務機關橫行霸道。愛國華人何賢、馬萬祺以及中共地下黨柯麟等人以強烈的愛國心與責任感團結同胞，凝聚澳門華人社團力量奮力反抗.

programme.title: 膽小鬼
programme.desc: 《膽小鬼》電視劇是由檸萌影業、優酷聯合出品，鄭執編劇，張曉波執導，歐豪、王硯輝領銜主演，王玉雯、周依然、侯雯元主演的青春懸疑犯罪短劇集。該劇改編自鄭執的長篇小說《生吞》，該劇講述了一段四個少年的青春往事，多年後一樁重現的罪案，讓所有人不得不面對人性最真實的「黑白戰爭」.

programme.title: 膽小鬼
programme.desc: 《膽小鬼》電視劇是由檸萌影業、優酷聯合出品，鄭執編劇，張曉波執導，歐豪、王硯輝領銜主演，王玉雯、周依然、侯雯元主演的青春懸疑犯罪短劇集。該劇改編自鄭執的長篇小說《生吞》，該劇講述了一段四個少年的青春往事，多年後一樁重現的罪案，讓所有人不得不面對人性最真實的「黑白戰爭」.

programme.title: 平凡之路
programme.desc: 潘岩(郭麒麟 飾)在機緣巧合下進入榮柯律所實習，認識了高冷女神左娜(金晨 飾)、學霸舒一南(晏紫東 飾)等一批年輕人。他們在資深前輩易帆(朱珠飾)、杜飛宇(張子賢飾)等人的帶領下，經歷了職場的波折坎坷和困難考驗，一起並肩作戰，互相學習成長，憑著熱情拼搏的職場精神，在情與法、義與利的境地裡突圍，更堅定了對法律的崇高信仰，同時也對自身的突破與飛躍有了新的認識與感悟，於職場和生活的路上守望初心，在平凡中創造不凡的「奮逗」故事.

programme.title: 唐朝詭事錄之長安
programme.desc: 先天二年夏秋之交，天子雖已登基，但大長公主勢力更盛，長安局勢陰晴難定。盧凌風和蘇無名，奉命帶著由裴喜君、費雞師、櫻桃和薛環組成的探案小隊，以護送康國所獻金桃的名義重返長安.

programme.title: 一閃一閃亮星星
programme.desc: 《一閃一閃亮星星》講述了林北星意外刪除舊手機中的短信回到過去，重新認識了昔日陌路校友張萬森，從而展開一段奇妙的時空拯救之旅的故事.

programme.title: 熾道
programme.desc: 在福建小島漁村長大的段宇成夢想成為一名跳高運動員，在助教羅娜的循序善誘之下，不僅訓練成績突飛猛進，兩人也在朝夕相處過程中情愫悄悄滋生，最終段宇成突破了極限也同時收穫了和羅娜的真摯愛情.

programme.title: 唐朝詭事錄之長安
programme.desc: 先天二年夏秋之交，天子雖已登基，但大長公主勢力更盛，長安局勢陰晴難定。盧凌風和蘇無名，奉命帶著由裴喜君、費雞師、櫻桃和薛環組成的探案小隊，以護送康國所獻金桃的名義重返長安.

programme.title: 一閃一閃亮星星
programme.desc: 《一閃一閃亮星星》講述了林北星意外刪除舊手機中的短信回到過去，重新認識了昔日陌路校友張萬森，從而展開一段奇妙的時空拯救之旅的故事.

programme.title: 月升滄海
programme.desc: 程家女名少商，因戰亂自幼被父母留在祖母身邊成為“留守兒童”，嬸孃狼心縱容，意圖將其養成廢人。面對重重陷阱，程少商（趙露思飾）為活命，假荒誕、真苦學，掩蓋鋒芒等待父母歸來。可撥開烏雲見月明時，卻因多年疏離致使親情已難再拾。缺愛的程少商，遇新帝義子凌不疑（吳磊飾）、白鹿山才子袁慎、世家子弟樓垚，三人各有優劣。在選擇適婚者上，程少商既自卑又務實，儘管情感之路頗多坎坷，但她從不後悔自己的每次選擇。在與凌不疑的相處之中，也陰差陽錯捲入了凌不疑的家庭與身世之謎中。種種事件，程少商屢立奇功，也從凌不疑的家庭關係中學會與父母相處之道，以及如何經營自己的愛情。同時程少商與凌不疑也在這些經歷中各自變化成長，慢慢與自己和家庭和解，並堅守內心的正義，攜手化解國家危機，成就一段佳話.

programme.title: 一閃一閃亮星星
programme.desc: 《一閃一閃亮星星》講述了林北星意外刪除舊手機中的短信回到過去，重新認識了昔日陌路校友張萬森，從而展開一段奇妙的時空拯救之旅的故事.

programme.title: 月升滄海
programme.desc: 程家女名少商，因戰亂自幼被父母留在祖母身邊成為“留守兒童”，嬸孃狼心縱容，意圖將其養成廢人。面對重重陷阱，程少商（趙露思飾）為活命，假荒誕、真苦學，掩蓋鋒芒等待父母歸來。可撥開烏雲見月明時，卻因多年疏離致使親情已難再拾。缺愛的程少商，遇新帝義子凌不疑（吳磊飾）、白鹿山才子袁慎、世家子弟樓垚，三人各有優劣。在選擇適婚者上，程少商既自卑又務實，儘管情感之路頗多坎坷，但她從不後悔自己的每次選擇。在與凌不疑的相處之中，也陰差陽錯捲入了凌不疑的家庭與身世之謎中。種種事件，程少商屢立奇功，也從凌不疑的家庭關係中學會與父母相處之道，以及如何經營自己的愛情。同時程少商與凌不疑也在這些經歷中各自變化成長，慢慢與自己和家庭和解，並堅守內心的正義，攜手化解國家危機，成就一段佳話.

programme.title: 平凡之路
programme.desc: 潘岩(郭麒麟 飾)在機緣巧合下進入榮柯律所實習，認識了高冷女神左娜(金晨 飾)、學霸舒一南(晏紫東 飾)等一批年輕人。他們在資深前輩易帆(朱珠飾)、杜飛宇(張子賢飾)等人的帶領下，經歷了職場的波折坎坷和困難考驗，一起並肩作戰，互相學習成長，憑著熱情拼搏的職場精神，在情與法、義與利的境地裡突圍，更堅定了對法律的崇高信仰，同時也對自身的突破與飛躍有了新的認識與感悟，於職場和生活的路上守望初心，在平凡中創造不凡的「奮逗」故事.

programme.title: 一閃一閃亮星星
programme.desc: 《一閃一閃亮星星》講述了林北星意外刪除舊手機中的短信回到過去，重新認識了昔日陌路校友張萬森，從而展開一段奇妙的時空拯救之旅的故事.

programme.desc: 程家女名少商，因戰亂自幼被父母留在祖母身邊成為“留守兒童”，嬸孃狼心縱容，意圖將其養成廢人。面對重重陷阱，程少商（趙露思飾）為活命，假荒誕、真苦學，掩蓋鋒芒等待父母歸來。可撥開烏雲見月明時，卻因多年疏離致使親情已難再拾。缺愛的程少商，遇新帝義子凌不疑（吳磊飾）、白鹿山才子袁慎、世家子弟樓垚，三人各有優劣。在選擇適婚者上，程少商既自卑又務實，儘管情感之路頗多坎坷，但她從不後悔自己的每次選擇。在與凌不疑的相處之中，也陰差陽錯捲入了凌不疑的家庭與身世之謎中。種種事件，程少商屢立奇功，也從凌不疑的家庭關係中學會與父母相處之道，以及如何經營自己的愛情。同時程少商與凌不疑也在這些經歷中各自變化成長，慢慢與自己和家庭和解，並堅守內心的正義，攜手化解國家危機，成就一段佳話.

programme.title: 平凡之路
programme.desc: 潘岩(郭麒麟 飾)在機緣巧合下進入榮柯律所實習，認識了高冷女神左娜(金晨 飾)、學霸舒一南(晏紫東 飾)等一批年輕人。他們在資深前輩易帆(朱珠飾)、杜飛宇(張子賢飾)等人的帶領下，經歷了職場的波折坎坷和困難考驗，一起並肩作戰，互相學習成長，憑著熱情拼搏的職場精神，在情與法、義與利的境地裡突圍，更堅定了對法律的崇高信仰，同時也對自身的突破與飛躍有了新的認識與感悟，於職場和生活的路上守望初心，在平凡中創造不凡的「奮逗」故事.

programme.title: 唐朝詭事錄之長安
programme.desc: 先天二年夏秋之交，天子雖已登基，但大長公主勢力更盛，長安局勢陰晴難定。盧凌風和蘇無名，奉命帶著由裴喜君、費雞師、櫻桃和薛環組成的探案小隊，以護送康國所獻金桃的名義重返長安.

programme.title: 一閃一閃亮星星

programme.title: 熾道
programme.desc: 在福建小島漁村長大的段宇成夢想成為一名跳高運動員，在助教羅娜的循序善誘之下，不僅訓練成績突飛猛進，兩人也在朝夕相處過程中情愫悄悄滋生，最終段宇成突破了極限也同時收穫了和羅娜的真摯愛情.

programme.desc: 程家女名少商，因戰亂自幼被父母留在祖母身邊成為“留守兒童”，嬸孃狼心縱容，意圖將其養成廢人。面對重重陷阱，程少商（趙露思飾）為活命，假荒誕、真苦學，掩蓋鋒芒等待父母歸來。可撥開烏雲見月明時，卻因多年疏離致使親情已難再拾。缺愛的程少商，遇新帝義子凌不疑（吳磊飾）、白鹿山才子袁慎、世家子弟樓垚，三人各有優劣。在選擇適婚者上，程少商既自卑又務實，儘管情感之路頗多坎坷，但她從不後悔自己的每次選擇。在與凌不疑的相處之中，也陰差陽錯捲入了凌不疑的家庭與身世之謎中。種種事件，程少商屢立奇功，也從凌不疑的家庭關係中學會與父母相處之道，以及如何經營自己的愛情。同時程少商與凌不疑也在這些經歷中各自變化成長，慢慢與自己和家庭和解，並堅守內心的正義，攜手化解國家危機，成就一段佳話.

programme.title: 唐朝詭事錄之長安
programme.desc: 先天二年夏秋之交，天子雖已登基，但大長公主勢力更盛，長安局勢陰晴難定。盧凌風和蘇無名，奉命帶著由裴喜君、費雞師、櫻桃和薛環組成的探案小隊，以護送康國所獻金桃的名義重返長安.

programme.title: 平凡之路
programme.desc: 潘岩(郭麒麟 飾)在機緣巧合下進入榮柯律所實習，認識了高冷女神左娜(金晨 飾)、學霸舒一南(晏紫東 飾)等一批年輕人。他們在資深前輩易帆(朱珠飾)、杜飛宇(張子賢飾)等人的帶領下，經歷了職場的波折坎坷和困難考驗，一起並肩作戰，互相學習成長，憑著熱情拼搏的職場精神，在情與法、義與利的境地裡突圍，更堅定了對法律的崇高信仰，同時也對自身的突破與飛躍有了新的認識與感悟，於職場和生活的路上守望初心，在平凡中創造不凡的「奮逗」故事.

programme.title: 一閃一閃亮星星
programme.desc: 《一閃一閃亮星星》講述了林北星意外刪除舊手機中的短信回到過去，重新認識了昔日陌路校友張萬森，從而展開一段奇妙的時空拯救之旅的故事.

programme.title: 熾道
programme.desc: 在福建小島漁村長大的段宇成夢想成為一名跳高運動員，在助教羅娜的循序善誘之下，不僅訓練成績突飛猛進，兩人也在朝夕相處過程中情愫悄悄滋生，最終段宇成突破了極限也同時收穫了和羅娜的真摯愛情.

programme.desc: 程家女名少商，因戰亂自幼被父母留在祖母身邊成為“留守兒童”，嬸孃狼心縱容，意圖將其養成廢人。面對重重陷阱，程少商（趙露思飾）為活命，假荒誕、真苦學，掩蓋鋒芒等待父母歸來。可撥開烏雲見月明時，卻因多年疏離致使親情已難再拾。缺愛的程少商，遇新帝義子凌不疑（吳磊飾）、白鹿山才子袁慎、世家子弟樓垚，三人各有優劣。在選擇適婚者上，程少商既自卑又務實，儘管情感之路頗多坎坷，但她從不後悔自己的每次選擇。在與凌不疑的相處之中，也陰差陽錯捲入了凌不疑的家庭與身世之謎中。種種事件，程少商屢立奇功，也從凌不疑的家庭關係中學會與父母相處之道，以及如何經營自己的愛情。同時程少商與凌不疑也在這些經歷中各自變化成長，慢慢與自己和家庭和解，並堅守內心的正義，攜手化解國家危機，成就一段佳話.

programme.title: 平凡之路
programme.desc: 潘岩(郭麒麟 飾)在機緣巧合下進入榮柯律所實習，認識了高冷女神左娜(金晨 飾)、學霸舒一南(晏紫東 飾)等一批年輕人。他們在資深前輩易帆(朱珠飾)、杜飛宇(張子賢飾)等人的帶領下，經歷了職場的波折坎坷和困難考驗，一起並肩作戰，互相學習成長，憑著熱情拼搏的職場精神，在情與法、義與利的境地裡突圍，更堅定了對法律的崇高信仰，同時也對自身的突破與飛躍有了新的認識與感悟，於職場和生活的路上守望初心，在平凡中創造不凡的「奮逗」故事.

programme.title: 唐朝詭事錄之長安
programme.desc: 先天二年夏秋之交，天子雖已登基，但大長公主勢力更盛，長安局勢陰晴難定。盧凌風和蘇無名，奉命帶著由裴喜君、費雞師、櫻桃和薛環組成的探案小隊，以護送康國所獻金桃的名義重返長安.

programme.title: 一閃一閃亮星星
programme.desc: 《一閃一閃亮星星》講述了林北星意外刪除舊手機中的短信回到過去，重新認識了昔日陌路校友張萬森，從而展開一段奇妙的時空拯救之旅的故事.

programme.title: 風與潮
programme.desc: 本劇講述二戰期間1942-1945年澳門「孤島」時期的抗戰風雲故事。 1941年12月香港淪陷後，澳葡政府名為“中立”，實則任由日軍澤榮作特務機關橫行霸道。愛國華人何賢、馬萬祺以及中共地下黨柯麟等人以強烈的愛國心與責任感團結同胞，凝聚澳門華人社團力量奮力反抗.

programme.title: 顯微鏡下的大明之絲絹案
programme.desc: 痴迷於數學的帥家默偶然發現金華縣一個歷史遺留問題，他在試圖糾正錯誤的過程中頻頻遇阻，並引發了各利益集團間的博弈。 軍戶出身的帥家默對數學極其感興趣，在一次拿各縣賦稅練習數學時，偶然發現有一筆科目叫作“人丁絲絹”稅收數目有疑點。經過查詢，帥家默知道有人偷換概念、移花接木，把原本各縣的賦稅轉嫁給了一個縣。帥家默瞭解此事後決定申訴，但在申訴過程中遇到重重困難，險些喪命，“人丁絲絹案”就此擱淺。後遇改革，舊案重提，經過帥家默和各方努力才讓真相大白於天下.

programme.title: 顯微鏡下的大明之絲絹案
programme.desc: 痴迷於數學的帥家默偶然發現金華縣一個歷史遺留問題，他在試圖糾正錯誤的過程中頻頻遇阻，並引發了各利益集團間的博弈。 軍戶出身的帥家默對數學極其感興趣，在一次拿各縣賦稅練習數學時，偶然發現有一筆科目叫作“人丁絲絹”稅收數目有疑點。經過查詢，帥家默知道有人偷換概念、移花接木，把原本各縣的賦稅轉嫁給了一個縣。帥家默瞭解此事後決定申訴，但在申訴過程中遇到重重困難，險些喪命，“人丁絲絹案”就此擱淺。後遇改革，舊案重提，經過帥家默和各方努力才讓真相大白於天下.

programme.title: 風與潮
programme.desc: 本劇講述二戰期間1942-1945年澳門「孤島」時期的抗戰風雲故事。 1941年12月香港淪陷後，澳葡政府名為“中立”，實則任由日軍澤榮作特務機關橫行霸道。愛國華人何賢、馬萬祺以及中共地下黨柯麟等人以強烈的愛國心與責任感團結同胞，凝聚澳門華人社團力量奮力反抗.

programme.title: 萌探探探案 第三季
programme.desc: 沉浸式IP推理真人秀，由謝娜、黃子韜、寧靜、古力娜扎、孫紅雷、孫千、徐志勝組成「萌探家族」，他們將根據一部經典IP，進行實景還原、改編等演繹原劇片段，通過劇情的疑點及遊戲環節，獲取劇情線索，尋找劇情真相.

programme.title: 日落時分說愛你
programme.desc: 熟齡戀愛旅居真人秀，10位性格各異、魅力全開的50+熟齡男女，帶著一顆敢愛的心，從大理到泰國，在日落時分開啟一段愛情之旅，一同打破恐老焦慮，傳遞歲月從不敗熱愛的生活態度.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾
programme.desc: 突破傳統的交友方式，24位單身女生以亮燈和滅燈方式來決定男嘉賓去留，通過「愛之初體驗」、「愛之再判斷」、「愛之終決選」、「男生權利」等決定男女嘉賓的速配成功.

programme.title: 全力以赴的行動派 第二季
programme.sub-title: 孟鶴堂代班秦霄賢上才藝
programme.desc: 由黃明昊、哈妮克孜、李宏毅、秦霄賢、趙小棠等嘉賓組成「探玩行動派」，以全新升級的劇情式玩法解鎖城市新風貌；他們將以最年輕、最活力的方式穿越各大城市，發揮創新的思維，創造出全新的有趣玩法.

programme.title: 傳承人 第三季
programme.desc: 非物質文化遺產即某地區文化傳承有重要意義的行為或表現，如民俗、文化、信仰、傳統等各種智慧財產；為了全面展示保護的成果，推動高品質發展，節目打造以非物質文化遺產傳承為主題，令更多人認識及發揚光大.

programme.title: 美好生活荔枝幫
programme.desc: 兼顧情緒價值輸出，為女性量身打造兼具時尚審美與人文關懷的變裝微綜藝，全方位多角度地向社會傳遞積極的生活態度；種草生活好物、推薦文旅線路、科普健康知識.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾 第16季
programme.sub-title: 不要在錯的時間遇見對的人
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情.

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚.

programme.title: 宇宙閃爍請注意
programme.sub-title: 全員同心同體解鎖身心默契
programme.desc: 重磅打造的全明星爆笑旅行遊戲真人秀，由黃曉明、黃子韜、劉耀文、邵子恆、王鶴棣、于洋組成「宇宙爆閃團」，用高能抽象任務，打造解壓式快樂體驗，去有趣的地方做有意義的事；放下偶像包袱，發送獨一無二的快樂訊號.

programme.title: 我們戀愛吧 第2季
programme.desc: 由伊能靜、黃聖依、朱正廷、金子涵、戴燕妮、張純燁6位常駐戀愛觀察員、微反應專家姜振宇以及鄭爽組成「戀愛觀察團」，見證素人嘉賓們從素不相識到牽手成功的浪漫愛情故事.

programme.title: 非遺有新人 第二季
programme.desc: 「青春守藝人」系列微紀錄片，穿越千年文脈，跋涉千山萬水，記錄傳統非遺的煥新故事，聆聽青春傳承的時代之音。一期一會，影像留住記憶，涵養精神文脈、厚植文化自信，向世界呈現絢爛多彩、賡續綿延的中華文明.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》全新改版，24位女嘉賓分為心動區和觀察區，男嘉賓暫不亮相，在「第二現場」與女嘉賓隔空對話。男女嘉賓通過雙向選擇，決定兩人能否成功牽手.

programme.title: 了不起的孩子 第3季 第3季
programme.desc: 由張紹剛與熒熒、陳爍等嘉賓主持組成學習團的一檔兒童脱口秀節目，一同走入「了不起學校」，發掘每個了不起孩子身上的天真、萌趣和了不起的技能.

programme.title: 火星情報局 第7季

programme.title: 勢均力敵的我們 第2季

programme.desc: 《一站到底》升級進入競速時代，答題拼速度，輸贏靠積分! 選手對決人數由10人變為8人，首度開啟搶答模式，除站位獎外再增豐富答題連擊獎，連續守擂三期的選手更有機會獲得高薪工作機會.

programme.title: 萬卷風雅集
programme.desc: 中的名場面，用現代方式表達其中蘊藏的經典文化與精神內涵，彰顯中華文明突出特性。邀請陳銘、喻恩泰、楊迪、王子異組成「萬卷遊學團」，羅一舟、張凌赫、張曉龍、王耀慶、王鶴棣、曾可妮作為「風雅體驗官」，分別體驗五場穿越千年的古今同游，根據遊學攻略不斷加載知識技能，最終完成「傳世名作名場面」的融創秀.

programme.title: 極限挑戰 第十季
programme.sub-title: 極挑兄弟為重生吃盡苦頭
programme.desc: 「極挑團」原班人馬將與新成員一起解鎖更多挑戰，他們將與廣大觀眾一起跨越大江南北，體驗國民生活百態，用真心探訪這片古老土地上正在發生的溫情故事，以更豐富的視角觸摸這卷山河下每一位個體的對美好生活的深切期望.

programme.title: 約見名醫
programme.desc: 全新研發的大型互動健康科普節目；從「重治療」到「重預防」，加大醫療健康知識的深度普及，把權威的資訊送到身邊.

programme.title: 追星星的人 第3季
programme.sub-title: 馬來「囧途」 開啟別樣文化之旅
programme.desc: 繼續重磅集結，除了經驗豐富的 “全勤者” 吳奇隆外，新成員林峯、丁禹兮、林允、趙小棠也加入「追星團」；在「星空日記」的魔法下，將打游戲的宅男、疲憊的職場打工人和沉浸於網上沖浪的情侶帶出原有空間一路滑行到戶外，讓受困於都市生活的他們探尋星空與美好的秘密.

programme.title: 煥新環遊傳

But what she needs is care which can't be bought. Sing, having a crush on Yu, always stands by her and comforts her desperate heart. Du Siheng couldn't adapt to the life on the grassland when she first arrived in Inner Mongolia. Touched by the love and warmth from the Mongolia people, the young Du Siheng gradually integrated into her new family. After six decades, the sister and brother reunited again and finally let go of the past. They reminisced the days when their fathers fought for the land beneath their feet and drew motivation from the older generation to work hard for a more promising and prosperous future.

He escapes to China and joins the Southern Shaolin Temple where he receives spiritual enlightenment and vows to protect his own country against the Japanese. Meanwhile, the Temple of Hades have set up a branch in China. It hosts daily fight competitions, openly challenging Chinese fighters. Many Chinese warriors, including prisoners-of-war from various nations, are killed in the arena and photographic evidence spread across the country as propaganda to crush the Chinese spirit. The Temple of Hades begins buying children again, training them to become assassins against their fellow Chinese.To rescue the children, Vajrasattva enters the Temple and challenges their fiercest Hade.

After witnessing the death of a family at the hands of a terrifying murderer, Keigo draws the murderer into his comic 34 and ends up creating a runaway hit. Co-starring Shun Oguri as a police detective chasing the serial killer, Character is a hair-raising chiller packed with unpredictable twists.

programme.desc: 2013, after the auction of items from Anita's estate, seemingly insignificant items are transported to a garbage dump. A number of fans try to salvage what they can in the dead of night. Undeterred by the conditions or the imminent threat of arrest, they work meticulously to save each of these treasures. Handwritten cards, letters and small hand-crafted gifts from fans, some even forgotten by the people who originally made them, every single one of these seemingly insignificant items kept and lovingly treasured by Anita over the years. Not wanting Anita's treasures to be condemned to landfills, these fans save and endeavour to return each of these to their original owner. Through their journey back to their original owner, we trace the stories of several fans whose lives were touched and forever changed by their chance encounters with their idol. Stories of: Growing confidence, Inspiration, Courage, Rekindled faith in people, and Friendship. Life may end but love and memorie.

A-cheng clumsily draws a “graffiti contract” to offset Hao-ting's debts with walks and dinners as dating, even tries his best to manage the funeral for her father. programme.desc: Entering the houses with the key entrusted to him by the clients, 'Koo Jung-tae', a real estate agent with a hobby of spying on other people's lives. She posts a photo of a vegan salad while actually eating convenience store sausage, prompting him to begin spying on her closely. ‘Koo Jung-tae', eventually sneaks into ‘Han Sora's house, discovers her lifeless body on the sofa. Soon after, he starts receiving threats from someone who knows he was there. As homicide detective 'Oh Young-joo's investigation closes in on him, ‘Koo Jung-tae' is compelled to search for the real culprit using clues from 'Han Sora's social media and the people around her.

programme.desc: High school student Yeon-gyu lives in a nightmare, where he needs to endure the physical abuse from his alcoholic stepfather. His only goal is to save enough money and escape from the living hell with his mother. One day, he gets into a fight and receives help from Chi-geon, an enigmatic gangster in the town. While the relationship of the two gradually develops into a brotherhood, Chi-geon is getting deeper in the swamp.

programme.title: 刺心切骨
programme.desc: Young fencer Zijie finds his world upended when his older brother, three-time national fencing champion Zihan, is released from juvenile prison. Featuring meticulously staged fencing matches and pitch-perfect performances, this unnerving psychodrama announces Nelicia Low as a future talent to follow.

Determined to regain everything she has lost, Su-young sets out to find Andy, who promised her the reward, but she soon encounters an even bigger and more dangerous force behind him..

programme.title: 北齋：浮世繪傳奇
programme.desc: In the Edo-era, young impecunious artist Katsushika Hokusai lived in downtown Edo. He was shabby and lived from hand to mouth with little money he earned by selling his painting on the streets. But Tsutaya Juzaburo, the one of a kind publisher, discovered Hokusai's hidden talent and led him to unleash his potentials. With Juzaburo's help, Hokusai found the essence of drawing and his talent bloomed. Meanwhile, the entertainment ban came in effect by the Edo shogunate. While Hokusai became older, he built a strong relationship with Ryutei Tanehiko, the popular playwright, who was born as a samurai and was distressed in creating new plays because of the prohibition. Eventually Tanehiko got executed by the shogunate. Hokusai came out with all his repulsion against the Edo shogunate on his vivid drawings.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 臨時劫案
programme.desc: Two perplexed middle-aged losers, Robby and Fai are good friends. Fai is honest man. His wife left him with an elderly home business. Fai has tried very hard to keep it running until the owner increases the rent crustily. Taxi driver Robby, who is timid and unreliable, he always neglected the conflicts between his mother and his wife. Robby always lives paycheck to paycheck without a financial plan, so he is at a loss what to do. There are two robberies involving the money exchange stores just across the street encourages Robby and Fai to get a gun and rob the same. It is a destiny to meet the ruthless bandit Mui, who acts wicked, scheming and chivalrous.

programme.title: 終極無間
programme.desc: Ten months after the murder of Yan (Tony Leung), Ming (Andy Lau) is relegated to the backseat of mundane office work, pending internal investigation. Exhausted mentally and physically, Ming is running on empty, but he is convinced that he can reverse his fortune in no time. Meanwhile, a new star has emerged in the police force. Hardly forty years old, Wing (Leon Lai) has already risen to the top echelon thanks to his illustrious track record..

programme.title: 北京樂與路
programme.desc: Yang Yin, a starry-eyed dance girl in search of love; Ping Lu, an impetuous Beijing Rock and Roll singer in search of recognition; and Michael, a Hong Kong-born and overseas-educated composer in search of himself. Three people from different walks of life are..

programme.title: 深刻每一「葉」: 殺出個黃昏
programme.desc: Last generation of assassins moved to HK in 50/60's and posted as “killer-for-hire' trio to fix all sort of problems for their clients. Decades passed, they now become redundant themselves at work and home. An accidental mission calls upon them turns out to be an assisted suicide. The trio suddenly finds new ‘life'.....as ”Guardian Angels of the Elders”. Just when they are finding meanings to this new role, an order from a teenager turns their new practice upside down again......this might as well be their very last job.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -哪吒2「聲」級三人組
programme.desc: Fish Liew, Jennifer Yu and Peter Chan Charm Man, have been invited to voice over Cantonese version of the animation film “Ne Zha 2”. This episode features these three actors sharing the joys and challenges of the dubbing process. While Fish tells that Cantonese has been a big challenge for her, Jennifer surprisingly wants to gigantify herself when asked which character's magic she would like to acquire and Peter also praises Fish even more! Let's find more fascinating behind-the-scenes stories they are going to share one by one.....

programme.title: 竊聽風雲2
programme.desc: LAW Man-seng is one of the most reputable securities dealers in Hong Kong. One day, he drives his luxury sports car and notices that a car is tailing him. His car finally crashes and Law is sent to the hospital. At the hospital, he sees a police officer HO Chi-keung, and thinks the officer is here for the car accident. But Ho works for the Department of Homeland Security which is responsible for counter-terrorism. Ho has found some surveillance devices in the wreckage of Law's sports car which are for military use..

programme.title: 傷城
programme.desc: In a city of love and prosperity, a city of lost hope and premature death, veteran detective Hei feels it all: the hurt, the helplessness, the horror. When his father-in-law, the billionaire benefactor Chau, is gruesomely murdered in his palatial mansion, he enlists the assistance of his former partner turned private detective, Bong.

programme.title: 重案行動之搗毒任務
programme.desc: A young girl died of drug addiction, revealing that a new type of drug is spreading rapidly in Hong Kong, affecting young people. The police take the incident seriously and set up an elite team from various departments to eradicate the entire drug cartel. The team investigated from various aspects of tracking, undercover, and forensics, and finally found that the mastermind behind turned out to be a genius drug refiner.

programme.title: 新宿事件
programme.desc: The foreign migrant communities in Tokyo live shadowy lives. The Japanese neither acknowledge nor welcome them. They are shunned by the mainstream society, hounded by the yakuza, and go about their days under fear of being discovered and repatriated. It is an alien world for Steelhead – an honest, hardworking tractor repairman. Steelhead had decided to take the perilous journey to Tokyo after he lost contact with his girlfriend, who had arrived in the city earlier.

programme.title: 非同凡響
programme.desc: Ms Tsui is a music teacher in a special education needs (SEN) school, who is not able to switch to a mainstream school due to stereotyping and labelling; Zoey is an underachiever from a Band 1 school, who is struggling for the coming public examination; Ka Ho is a rebellious teenager from a Band 3 school, who idles away his time and doesn't care about his handicapped little brother...Fate drives the three to take part in a musical they deem worthless for their own purposes, which turns out to be a journey of self-discovery towards their dreams and goals.

programme.title: 烏托邦浩劫
programme.desc: The world has been reduced to rubble by a massive earthquake.While no one knows for sure how far the ruins stretch, or what the cause of the earthquake may be, in the heart of Seoul there is only one apartment building left standing. It is called Hwang Gung Apartments. As time passes, outsiders start coming in to Hwang Gung Apartments trying to escape the extreme cold. Before long, the apartment residents are unable to cope with the increasing numbers. Feeling a threat to their very survival, the residents enact a special measure.

programme.title: 葉問3
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, in Hong Kong which is under British colonial rule, Frank, a foreign property developer who colludes with the gangs and even the Police, is reclaiming houses and a school from the local community. It is not a good time for the Wing Chun master Ip Man to deal with young Bruce Lee who just applied for an apprenticeship. For the good of the people, he steps forward and re-enters the “battlefield”. In collaboration with another Wing Chun practitioner Tin Chi, Ip Man rescues the children kidnapped by the gangs..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 少年的你
programme.desc: On the cusp of China's competitive national college entrance exams, Nian, a 17-year-old schoolgirl becomes the target of school bullying after a fellow classmate committed suicide. She later discovers an unlikely ally in Bei, an orphaned street youth. He becomes her protector and they form a unique bond that is soon tested when they are both implicated in a murder.

programme.title: 與神同行：終極審判
programme.desc: Su-hong and his 3 Afterlife Guardians journey through 7 hells in order for all them to be reincarnated, while a household god defies all rules to help ordinary people in the living world. And the afterlife guardian's tragic lives on earth thousand years ago are uncovered one by one during their battle against the god in human world.

programme.title: 家有囍事2020
programme.desc: The Yau's brothers are a trio of scammers who make punishing baddies their mission. A misunderstanding leads them to fellow con artists the Lui's sisters, and they join hands to scam a notorious mob boss. Through a myriad of ingenious tricks and disguises, they bring the mobster to justice as romance blossoms swiftly..

programme.title: 不再讓你孤單
programme.desc: When they first meet, no one can see this coming. She is a young, aggressive Beijing-based real estate agent from Hong Kong carrying an affair with a married man who also happens to be her boss. He is an honest but way too rigid policeman in his midlife crisis, who remains single to take care of his kid brother. A chance encounter in a karaoke lounge leads to an unlikely friendship. While he becomes infatuated with her, finding her pronunciation of his name the most dulcet tune he has ever heard, she is wrestling with being dumped by her boss and fired from her job at the same time. She eventually runs off to Hong Kong after borrowing almost his entire savings..

programme.title: 深刻每一「葉」: 毒。誡
programme.desc: This is a true story based on a repented gangster preaching the word of God and guiding his brotherhood to turn over a new leaf. Chen once was the leader of the famous gang “The 13 Tsz Wan Shan”, he lost his family, lovers, brothers and finally ended up imprisoned for his drug abuse and trafficking. After jail, he devoted himself to save the lost fellows and was selected as “The JCI Hong Kong Ten Outstanding Young Persons”. Being respected by the world, Chen is always asked to solve the most difficult situations between evil and good. People give him a nickname “The Fixer”. However, there are two sides of a coin, Chen can work out any problem of others, he does not know how to deal with his personal knot with his love, with whom he has had guilty conscience all his life. Can he fix it eventually.

programme.title: 曾經擁有
programme.desc: Anyone who has anything to do with the film industry in Hong Kong, must have heard of a film buff called Lil' Kim. He knows everything there is to know about filmmaking. Whether it's on the set, at the movie premiere or at a press conference, he always shows up uninvited. Nobody knows where he came from and why he showed up... Ginger Keung is the producer of a reality show who suspects Lil' Kim is in fact a film critic who pans movies to extort advertising dollars from film companies. She zeroes in on Lil' Kim as her next target and decides to dig into his elusive past..

programme.title: 手機見鬼
programme.desc: Lily, a popular YouTuber reeling from her boyfriend's betrayal, discovers a haunted phone belonging to Xiaoya, a bullied high school student who tragically took her own life. As eerie messages and calls pull Lily into Xiaoya's ghost world, she learns of the spirit's desire for revenge against those who hurt her. Empathizing with Xiaoya's pain, Lily begins to understand the quest for justice. However, she soon realizes that helping Xiaoya seek vengeance comes at a steep cost, and some hauntings can never truly be escaped.

programme.title: 秘密之丘
programme.desc: Sensitive 12-year-old Myung-eun (Moon Seung-a) is embarrassed of her working-class family and constantly lies to keep her true family situation a secret. When she writes, though, she is not constrained by reality. Pouring herself into essays, Myung-eun takes pride in constructing a different world of her own. However, the candid writings of a new student shake her sense of self, and prompt Myung-eun to better understand her family. Reminiscent of acclaimed coming-of-age Korean indies like The World of Us and House of Hummingbird, writer-director Lee Ji-eun's understated debut feature excels in its perceptive depiction of the emotions and experiences of a child trying to find her place in the world.

programme.title: 總理之夫
programme.desc: Ornithologist (a scholar of birds) Hiyori Soma is married to Rinko, leader of a minority political party. One morning, his beloved wife poses an enigmatic question. “Hey, Hiyori, would you have a problem if I became Prime Minister?” He asks her to repeat the question, but she shrugs him off. Still confused, he sets off for a ten-day expedition on a remote island with no cell phone connection to observe birds in the wild. In his absence, Rinko changes the future of the nation! She is elected the first female Prime Minister in Japan's history, making Hiyori the first ever Prime Minister's husband. He was always 100% supportive of Rinko's political ambitions, but could never have imagined the life that awaited him..

programme.title: 非分熟女
programme.desc: Born in a culinary family, Siu Man has always led an ideal life - Good grades, a financially viable job and a loving husband. But one thing has always plagued her: A fear of intimacy. After the end of her sexless marriage and several life crises, Siu Man reboots her life by taking over her father's restaurant. She hires Jiahao, a ‘culinary philosopher' who takes a creative approach to cooking. To help save the restaurant, Jiahao decides to mentor Siu Man, opening her up to his culinary world. In the process, Siu Man becomes attracted to his masculinity, intelligence and his mastery of culinary skills. After seeing her usually conservative friends let loose at a wedding party, Siu Man realizes that it's time to tackle her fear of intimacy head-on. With the help of a new friend, Siu Man embarks on a journey of liberation, starting with pole dancing lessons and returning to the dating scene. When she secretly spies on Jiahao's wild tryst with another woman, Siu Man finally exper.

programme.title: 西遊記之孫悟空三打白骨精
programme.desc: 500 years after the havoc in heaven, Xuanzang, the Tang Priest, is appointed by the Buddha to go to the West to fetch the Buddhist scriptures. By accident, Xuangzang undoes the Buddha's spell on Sun Wukong, the Monkey King. Wukong brought under control by a gold hoop given by the Mercy Goddess. He has no choice but to accept the mission to escort Xuanzang to the West. Despite his reluctance. Wukong cuts paths all the way and dutifully helps to subdue Bajie and Sha. But the hoop on this head, effective with his master's restrictive incantation, always remains a vexation for Wukong. Lady White Bone Spirit from the White Tiger Ridge aims to kill and eat Xuanzang's golden body for evading her doom of reincarnation from a demon to any other creature. After dealing with the four, White Bone Spirit has an insight into the barrier between Wukong and Xuanzang. So, she designs traps to foment discord between them. Humiliated mistakenly, Wukong still fights on with both strength and wit.

programme.title: 年少日記
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng looks back to his repressed childhood memories, as he finds an anonymous suicide note in the classroom. He strives hard to prevent another tragedy from happening, meanwhile facing a series of family problems, his wife is divorcing him, and his father is dying.

programme.title: 快一秒的他
programme.desc: Hajime is a handsome young man, who is always a second quicker than everyone else. He works at the post office, where Reika comes to buy a stamp every day. Reika is a young woman, who is always a second slower than everyone else. On the day after Valentine's Day, Hajime wakes up to find himself losing all his memories from the previous day... A remake of the Best Film Winner at the Taipei Golden Horse Awards, My Missing Valentine, and relocating the story to Kyoto, the film tells a quirky romance caught in unexpected time differences.

programme.title: 浪漫特攻隊
programme.desc: Yeo-rae is a retired national superstar in Korea. During her holiday on a South Pacific Island, she gets married to Jonathan, a tycoon who she initially thought of as her prince charming but turns out to be a control freak. With the help of her neighbour Beom-wu, who happens to be a die-hard fan of Yeo-rae, she is going to get herself out of the cage with a murder plan.

programme.title: 飛翔吧﹗埼玉2
programme.desc: A live-action film adaptation of Mineo Maya's “Fly Me to the Saitama” turned out to be a huge, unexpected box office hit of 2019. With the producers who took the demand for a sequel as real, the cast and crew got back together to complete the second chapter of the urban legend in Fly Me To The Saitama -FROM BIWA LAKE WITH LOVE-. In addition to the biting yet affectionate dissing of Saitama and the Kanto region in the first film, the sequel contains an even more scathing dissing of the Kansai region. Alongside costars GACKT and Fumi Nikaido, Ryo Kato and Tsubasa Masuwaka reprise their roles as members of the Saitama Liberation Front. A crucial protagonist who joins their battle, Kai Kikyo, the handsome leader of the Shiga Liberation Front, is played by Anne in her first role as male character. Akira Kashoji, the ruthless governor of Osaka and kingpin of the Kansai region who stands in the way of Rei and others, is played by Ainosuke Kataoka. In addition to Norika Fujiwara and.

programme.title: 飯戲攻心
programme.desc: It is often said that food and meals bring families together, but in TABLE FOR SIX it's clear that not all family gatherings are a cause for celebration. In this melodramatic comedy, three brothers reside in a home that they inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother Steve (Dayo Wong), theoretically is the man of the house, but he constantly is getting dissed by his two younger brothers Bernard (Louis Cheung Kai Chung) and Lung (Chan Charm Man Peter) for the decisions he makes, the inedible meals that he cooks, and his complicated romantic encounters. To prepare for a family reunion dinner, Steve seeks the help of Lung's girlfriend and foodie Josephine (Ivana Wong) and in doing so, wins back their hearts for a while, until his old flame and Bernard's new girlfriend Monica (Stephy Tang) shows up. That's a recipe for a disaster waiting to explode! The unexpected visit of Steve's part-time girlfriend Meow (Lin Min-Chen) not only fails to turn down the heat and cool th.

programme.title: 桃姐
programme.desc: Ms. Zhong Chun-tao had served the Leung's family as a domestic helper since the age of 13. Time went fast and the past sixty years flew by. During this time, some members of the Leung's family had passed away, whilst the rest had emigrated and left the country for good. For the past decade, sister Tao and the only successor of the family, Roger, were the sole remaining members. The master-servant relationship between the two was well and supportive through mutual understanding, but lack of proper communication. One day thereafter, sister Tao was found suffering from..

programme.title: 深刻每一「葉」: 飯戲攻心2
programme.desc: Belief in our own blessings can bring us good fortune, but what is true fortune? Fortune and misfortune, love and hate, what is their ultimate definitions? One family, three couples, three weddings. After they decided to move on, what further challenges await them? Marriage isn't just about two individuals; it involves a whole family of aunts, uncles, and cousins. Sunny Chan, with his unique sense of humor, once again dives into the complex dynamics of modern society's men and women, families and romance.

programme.title: 沉默的證人
programme.desc: A cat-and-mouse game unfolds over a single night when three armed criminals barge into a morgue, demanding the forensic doctor and his assistant to hand over a bullet lodged inside a corpse. While the criminals are in a desperate attempt to hide their true identities, the doctor finds himself sinking deeper and deeper into a quagmire as his past inadvertently catches up with him. Each explosive twist soon pushes the characters beyond their limits.

programme.title: 無間對決
programme.desc: Major Crimes captain Park Kang-yoon (Cho Jin-woong) receives special funding to carry out his investigations and lives the life of luxury with fancy sedan, high-end condo, designer suits and accessories. A rookie named Min-jae (Choi Woo-shik) joins his unit, who happens to be very by the book. The pair becomes close as they begin investigating a new type of street drug, but Kang-yoon finds out that there is a mole within his unit, who has been compiling a case against him. As Min-jae is shown into the shady world of slush funds being used on cops, he is exposed to a secret organization within the ranks..

programme.title: 追捕
programme.desc: Manhunt follows the journey of upstanding lawyer Du Qiu, who is unwittingly drawn into a murder case when all the evidence at the scene points to him being the perpetrator. Knowing that he's been framed by Luo Zhi, Du Qiu runs from the law to uncover the truth. The police launch a large-scale manhunt, but veteran detective Yamura sees that this seemingly open-and-shut case is not that simple after all. During the intense pursuit, a bond begins to build between the fugitive and his pursuer, even though Yamura knows that he can't fully trust Du Qiu. Is the real killer lurking elsewhere? Is there a hidden conspiracy behind the murder.

programme.title: 拳霸無銀用
programme.desc: Thongpoon wants to produce a movie by using his gift of martial art to be a leading actor. Without money, he joins a boxing gambling for finding funds, but at last he becomes a prizefighter unexpectedly.

programme.title: 好好拍電影
programme.desc: On a buzzing red carpet, a 70-year-old short-haired woman strides towards the stage with confidence. Behind the red carpet, it's a muddy path that leads to a movie studio in New Territories, Hong Kong. To her, glory and hardship are nothing more than just different paths that lead to the world of cinema. Born in Northeastern China, raised in Macau and educated in Hong Kong, Ann Hui stays true to her cultural heritage as a Chinese, yet she has always been fascinated by Western literature and therefore decided to further her studies in London. Eventually, she found movies. Through movies, she becomes fully immersed into the ‘East-meets-West' culture and lifestyle of Hong Kong; She reconciles with her distant mother; And she gets to explore the cultural and social identity of her and the city she calls home. Movies also found her. Having learned from veteran auteur King Hu, her directorial debut became part of the impetus behind Hong Kong's New Wave as she explores marginalize.

programme.title: 男航女機師
programme.desc: HAN Jung-woo, a pilot with top-class skills, is flying high and even appears on a famous TV show. But everything comes crashing down when a careless mistake causes him to lose everything, even his job. Blacklisted in the industry, no airline is willing to hire him. Desperate with no other choice, HAN Jung-woo transforms completely into his younger sister's identity and succeeds in landing a job as a pilot. But soon, he encounters more unexpected problems... Will his dream of cruising through life ever take off.

programme.title: LAST MILE：全面引爆
programme.desc: On the day before the Black Friday sale, a box delivered by a global e-commerce company, explodes. The box was sent from one of the biggest warehouses, which has the three-quarter logistic shares around Tokyo. It leads a series of mysterious bombings that terrorize whole of Japan. Elena Funado, who was just appointed as a new director of the warehouse, is forced to control this unprecedented situation with a line manager, Ko Nashimoto. Who planted the bombs? For what purpose? How many bombs are left? - And where are they now? In this modern society, distribution service becomes critical need for our lives and that cannot be stopped. Can Elena and Ko end the serial bombings without stopping blood flowed in “blood vessel”; the global logistics system like a web.

programme.title: 爆谷巨星匯：林峯: 忠烈楊家將
programme.desc: The plot places focus on how the seven sons of the Yang family held hands in the rescue of their father. During a series of battles in a place called Jinsha, they pitted the few against the Khitans. Despite in great peril, they never lose faith or gave up their mission to save their father..

programme.title: 看我今天怎麼說
programme.desc: Wolf, born into a Deaf family, embraces sign language with confidence despite obstacles in life; Sophie, having a cochlear implant at a young age, continuously strives to be seen as 'normal', despite struggling with oral language. Alan, with a cochlear implant like Sophie, is capable of both oral and sign language; he advocates for diverse modes of communication within the deaf community. Bound by love and friendship, the three embark on a self-discovering journey with their own moments of pain.

programme.title: 銀河寫手
programme.desc: A group of young people dreaming of becoming directors, screenwriters, actors, producers, and more. Among them were two screenwriters, Zhang Liaoyi and Sun Tan. They wrote a movie script that they believed would go down in history and were determined to bring it to the big screen.

programme.title: 寒戰雙戰線: 寒戰
programme.desc: Approaching midnight in Hong Kong, police headquarters receives an anonymous call: a police van carrying the advanced equipment and five officers has disappeared off the grid..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -寒戰前哨站
programme.desc: The long-awaited “Cold War” series returns! Director Longman Leung together with Terrance Lau and Louise Wong disclose the untold stories of filming “Cold War 1994”. While Terrance reveals filming car chase scenes had been his brush with death, Louise confesses to being stressed to play the role of a gang boss for the first time that took her three months of preparation for the action scenes. Longman also shares about the tycoon kidnapping case in the film inspired by real cases from the 1990s.....

programme.title: 爆谷獨家首播: 新．超人
programme.desc: The continued appearance of giant unidentified life forms known as “S-Class Species (Kaiju)” has become commonplace in Japan. Conventional weapons have no effect on them. Having exhausted all other options, the Japanese Government issued the S-Class Species Suppression Protocol and formed an enforcement unit, known as the SSSP. The members chosen for the unit are: captain Kimio Tamura, strategic planner Shinji Kaminaga, unparticle physicist Akihisa Taki, and biologist Yumi Funaberi. In the midst of a Kaiju threat, a silver giant appears from beyond Earth's atmosphere. Analyst Hiroko Asami is newly appointed to the SSSP to deal with this giant and is partnered with Shinji Kaminaga. In Hiroko's report, she writes-“Ultraman, identity unknown.

programme.title: 門徒
programme.desc: Nick is undercover in Asia's crime trade as he plays protege to a key player, 'Banker', for 8 years. However, as He is more trusted by Banker, he finds himself gradually corrupted..

programme.title: 意外
programme.desc: Young-il is a plotter who manipulates murder-for-hire cases to look like accidents. Nobody knows those accidents are in fact perfectly plotted, planned murders. After finishing a flawlessly plotted case with no trace of evidence left behind, Young-il receives a new request. His new target is a prominent political figure who is always under the spotlight. Even with the higher risk of getting exposed, Young-il decides to take the case with his team members, Jackie, Wol-cheon, and Jeom-man. When the plot is ready after immaculate preparation and numerous rehearsals, the team finally makes its move, but some unexpected trouble threatens Young-il's perfect plan.

programme.title: 該死的阿修羅
programme.desc: During the night of his 18th birthday, Jan-Wen committed a random shooting homicide in the crowed night-market, with his self-made modified gun and for some mysterious reasons. The tragic incident caused the life of his family and friends, the victims, and the witnesses all facing the tremendous impact in the aftermath. However, what if there was a chance for these people to make different choices, will the tragedy remain? Will it be a brand new outcome if they all altered their behavior at the crucial moment.

programme.title: 超級無敵羊咩咩大電影之天外飛咩
programme.desc: When a visitor from beyond the stars – an impish and adorable alien called LU-LA – crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm, Shaun soon sees an opportunity for alien-powered fun and adventure, and sets off on a mission to shepherd LU-LA back to her home... Little do the pair know, though, that they are being pursued at every turn by a mysterious alien-hunting government agency, spearheaded by the formidable Agent Red and her bunch of hapless, hazmat-suited goons. Can Shaun and the flock avert Farmageddon on Mossy Bottom Farm before it's too late.

credits.director: 李察菲蘭, 威爾比察

programme.title: 歡迎來到駒田蒸餾所
programme.desc: Kotaro, a novice editor for a web news, visits Komada Distillery for a project on Japanese craft whisky. Led by a young female president Rui who recently took over the family business, the distillery works hard to reproduce its signature whisky KOMA they had to stop making years ago. KOMA was a brand that Rui's family had lovingly preserved over generations and a symbol of happiness for all. However, not to mention financial backing, too many clues are missing to revive the whisky once lost. Rui, Kotaro, and the distillery supporters pull together every thread to bring back the whisky filled with family memories.

programme.title: 低一點的天空
programme.desc: Fat Cat, a nickname because of his chubby body, is a moderately mentally handicapped person. He works happily and passionately as a delivery boy in a restaurant. Little Cheung is a spastic with normal IQ working as an office boy. Fairy Snow White, name it after a renowned Chinese opera actress, is a blissful, middle-class daughter. Her bright future suddenly turned vague when she became blind at age twelve. From then on, she is living in the dark, but her childhood memories enable her to live in peace and harmony. Fat Cat, Little Cheung and Snow White become good friends afterwards, sharing their respective dream. They don't think it is feasible except Fat Cat does..

programme.title: 劍雨
programme.desc: In 428AD, Bodhi, Prince of Southern India, becomes a Buddhist monk and sets off for China, earning a hallowed reputation as a mystical martial artist. Following his death, his remains mysteriously disappear. It is rumored that his remains contain the secret to obtaining limitless power and ruling the martial arts world. Centuries later, The Dark Stone emerges as a team of deadly assassins; their best assassin is the ruthless, invincible Drizzle. On her latest mission, Drizzle takes out Zhang Haiduan, a high-ranking court official. Zhang's son, Renfeng, while mourning his father's death, is also attacked and seemingly killed by Drizzle and her fellow assassins. Drizzle's life changes when she kills Lu Zhu, a monk with whom she has unintentionally fallen in love..

programme.title: 從今以後
programme.desc: Angie and Pat are a lesbian couple who have been together for over four decades. Pat bought an apartment over thirty years ago where they have lived ever since. The couple is open to their families and often invites Pat's family to their home for dinners. Angie's relationship with them has always been very close. When Pat passes away unexpectedly, Angie is suddenly left on her own to deal with matters related to Pat and her estate. It is not too long before a clash develops over their opinions about the burial arrangements. Angie begins to feel increasingly alienated from Pat's family..

programme.title: 絕世好賓
programme.desc: A man is hired to look after a spoiled rich girl, but is then pulled into a scheme meant to re-evaluate her life.

programme.title: 哪吒之魔童降世
programme.desc: The aura from heaven and earth has given birth to a powerful pearl inserted with huge energy. Yuanshi Tianzun (the Primeval Lord of Heaven) concocts two pills out of the pearl – a spiritual pill (Ling Zhu) and a sorcery pill (Mo Wan). He then seals both of them in the seven-colored sacred lotus. The spiritual pill will reincarnate as a man, who is destined to assist in the creation of the new Zhou dynasty; whilst a demon will be born of the sorcery pill, who is set to bring great destructions to the world. To prevent disasters, Yuanshi Tianzun has initiated a kalpa spell to strike the sorcery pill with thunder in three years. Facing the advent of the thunder, will Nezha still be the demon as destined? What will he choose.

programme.title: 哪吒之魔童鬧海（粵語配音版
programme.desc: Ne Zha returns again joining by versatile stars - Jennifer Yu, Fish Liew and Peter Chan, who bring their unique voices and witty dialogue to the adventures of Ne Zha and Ao Bing and breathe a new life into the story. After the heavenly lightning, although Ne Zha and Ao Bing survived by becoming spirits, they would soon dissipate completely. Taiyi plans to rebuild Ne Zha and Ao Bing's mortal bodies with the Seven-colored Precious Lotus. However, during the process of reconstruction, numerous obstacles arise. Together, they embark on a new journey to challenge their fate.

programme.title: 寒戰雙戰線: 寒戰2
programme.desc: The story of this highly-anticipated sequel continues as Acting Police Commissioner Sean Lau (Aaron Kwok) is promoted to the highest rank in the police force. Joe (Eddie Peng Yuyan), son of Deputy Police Commissioner Waise Lee (Tony Leung Ka Fai) who is behind the conspiracy, is taken into custody and Waise is forced to retire. But Master, Themind remains unknown, until the resurface of a former police chief who unveils an unprecedented scheme to corrupt the police force. Things get more complicated when senior counsel Oswald Kan (Chow Yun Fat) leads an impeachment proceeding against Sean. Oswald's every decision is pivotal in determining who stays on top of the game.

programme.title: 港片「詭」之道: 恐怖在線
programme.desc: In 2003, a collision between a double-decker bus and a truck in Tuen Mun took the lives of 21 people. Ten years after the accident, several tenants on the Yau Oi Estate, which is located near the scene of the collision, report witnessing a woman clad in red jumping to her death on multiple nights, prompting veteran police officer Gu to go investigate with rookie cop Bee At the same time, radio DJ Poon Siu Chung returns to the site of the Tuen Mun collision with a group of students hoping to investigate the circumstances of the crash. When strange things start happening to the students, Gu and Bee are called to help. The two seemingly unconnected investigations converge as Gu realizes the incidents are connected.

programme.title: 片場職人 -張兆輝
programme.desc: Cheung Siu Fai, who started his career in television, won the appreciation of director Johnnie To with his precise and solid performance and participated in hit films such as “Running On Karma”, “Election” and “Exiled”. In this episode, Siu Fai is invited to disassemble the design of his classic characters, talk about his friend-and-mentor-like relationship with Johnnie To and share his steadily progressing acting career.

programme.title: 殭屍先生
programme.desc: Mr. Yan calls in Chinese voodoo priest Kou to handle the reburial of his dad. The corpse rises and becomes a vampire. It first kills Mr. Yan and roams about for new victims..

programme.title: 千王
programme.desc: Taiwanese swindler Mr. Giant loses in a poker match against Hong Kong swindler Wong Sheung Chin and they become sworn enemies. Meanwhile, Wong's apprentice Snake Wai meets Susan, a widow whom recently returned to Hong Kong from Singapore. Planning to con a big sum of money from her, Wai sets up a plan with his acquaintances Yam Sei-sung and Yip Mei-mei. However, Susan turns out to be a swindler as well. Unable to salvage a fortune from Susan, Wai, Sung and Mei become indebted to her. In desperation, Wai seeks help from his mentor and he has won back all the debts they owed Susan..

programme.title: 繼續跳舞
programme.desc: Chang and Ao are twin sisters. Ao is a lunatic and stays in a mental hospital. Chang is 'cheated' into the hospital, exchanging identity with her insane sister. The mad house is lived by all kinds of weirdos. The 'game' is that Chang will stay in the hospital only for a while. But strangely enough, she gradually becomes more and more ease with the way of life in the hospital until one day, she's forgotten what life is like outside, including her fiance. Meanwhile, Ao is out looking for her ex-husband Ma Shih-mei who heartlessly deserted her. She meets the postman who has a secret infatuation with Chang. She also makes an acquaintance with millionaire Sugar Old Man. The three of them develop the most harmonious friendship over..

programme.title: 富貴逼人
programme.desc: News reporter Bill and his wife live in a public housing flat with their 3 daughters. Their dream is to get rich someday. When Lady Luck comes knocking on their door one day and they win the first prize of the local lottery, Mark Six, all hell break loose..

programme.title: 快餐車
programme.desc: Thomas and David are two quick-witted vendors hawking Chinese fast food from their truck in the busy squares of Barcelona. Their acquaintance with beautiful pickpocket, Sylvia, brings them in contact with novice detective Moby, who is trying to track her whereabouts. Sylvia is actually a wealthy heiress kidnapped by the evil count, who is trying to siphon off her inheritance. The trio puts a spanner in the count's plans, and rescue Sylvia..

programme.title: 三人新世界
programme.desc: Advertising professional Alex, has been living with Chu Lai Ngo and her daughter Vivian, in harmony. Alex has to go to Paris with director Joe, for ad production. Due to the suspicion of Alex's fidelity, Chu and Vivian follow Alex to Paris and cause dramatic argument with Joe. Because Chu feels her relationship with Alex is in danger, she threatens Alex to marry her once they return to Hong Kong. Otherwise, she will marry Alex's cousin and go to Canada..

programme.title: 愛上我吧
programme.desc: Lobo and Skid are very close friends. They study in the same class, and they both grow up without their mothers. The two buddies often play in a band and play skateboards with their classmates. Soda, one of their classmates, has many girlfriends concurrently, and Suki is his closet girlfriend. Fion is another classmate. She is addicted to chat in phone with friends and strangers every day. She always thinks she will find a true love from playing line. One day, she has an argument with her boyfriend on street, and Pat, an innocent girl, saw the incident..

programme.title: 爆谷星影好戲: 執法先鋒
programme.desc: Ha Ling Ching, a mild-mannered prosecutor who takes the law into his own hands, when the legal system fails to capture the most notorious criminals. As the police assign a tough, gutsy inspector Cindy to stop Ha's vigilante hunting out of court, another murder brings them together in the search for the real killer, who may or may not be one of their own.

programme.title: 點指兵兵
programme.desc: A young man who was addicted to firearms wanted to be admitted to the police. He was not admitted because of his eye disease, which caused him psychological imbalance and he killed people everywhere. The police set up a special unit to arrest him. A fledgling policeman met the murderer on a narrow road..

programme.title: 殭屍先生
programme.desc: Mr. Yan calls in Chinese voodoo priest Kou to handle the reburial of his dad. The corpse rises and becomes a vampire. It first kills Mr. Yan and roams about for new victims..

programme.title: 呆佬拜壽
programme.desc: Ji Fu, the successor of Ji's family, becomes an idiot after being knocked out in an 'accident' created by the second-successor Ji Jack. After being an idiot, Fu meets Mon Tee..

programme.title: 影人映語 -李麗珍
programme.desc: Lee Lai Chun, a cinema goddess in the 1980s and 90s, has made her appearances in numerous Hong Kong movies. She seems to be a productive actress; but she admits that comparing to Carol ‘Dodo' Cheng or Sandra Ng who both has simultaneously worked on 9 film sets, doing 3 films at the same time for her is already exhausting enough. When she talks about the mode of filmmaking then and now, she misses and cherishes her family bonding with Tung Piu and Lydia Shum on the sets of the classic Lunar-New-Year series IT'S A MAD MAD MAD WORLD. Being in the film industry for over 30 years, though she has been awarded the Golden Horse Best Leading Actress, she regretfully says that she has not seen the birth of her own iconic role. Then, what does her ideal representative work looks like.

programme.title: 沙灘仔與周師奶
programme.desc: Beach Boy and Mrs. Chow have been partners in the police force for years. While investigating a special case, Beach Boy met Ah Yuk whose step-father was one of the crime members. Ah Yuk was alone in Hong Kong and Beach Boy first pitied her, then later fell in love with her. Beach Boy's superior, Inspector Lee Nam who appears to be honest is actually one of the Taiwanese group. He set up Beach Boy and Mrs. Chow. He also courted Ah Yuk..

programme.title: 花心夢裏人
programme.desc: Fat Chiu and Frankie live together on a temporary basis. During their stay at home, they spend time with one of the home-mate Kwan and consequently build up very close relationship. Sally, who is Frankie's girlfriend, is deeply in romance with Frankie. However, when Pauline, a billionaire turns up, Frankie is crazily attracted by her. He decides to give up Sally. On the other hand, Fat Chiu immediately proceeds his plan and shows his care and love to Sally. Although Sally is so touched of the sincerity of Fat Chiu and accepts his offer, she knows she still loves Frankie. Kwan opines that Sally is damaging female dignity. Likewise, Kwan also disgraces Frankie as he sacrifices both his lover and friendship, simply because of his personal desire..

programme.title: 開心鬼救開心鬼
programme.desc: Hong Sum Kwai is enjoying a second life in metropolis Hong Kong. His girlfriend, Annie, is oblivious to the fact that her former incarnation was the village girl who perished the General to eternal suffering. Hong Sum Kwai teaches at the school where Annie's father serves as the principal. There are four sprightly yet mischievous male students in Hong Sum Kwai's charge, but they are duped by the girls and left stranded in the wilderness discovering the dead body of the General..

programme.title: 陰陽錯
programme.desc: Koo, an insurance investigator, is sent to make enquiries regarding a case of accidental death. He is surprised to learn that the victim is the same ghost who has spoken to him the night before. Koo is fascinated in working on the case. One night, Yu's spirit appeared in Koo's apartment. Her beauty and pleasant personality intrigued Koo. They get involved into a romance between man and a spirit. Will Koo and Yu be reunited or will Yu remain, as always, Koo's esprit d'amour?

programme.title: 影人映語 -大哥大唔易做 – 洪金寶
programme.desc: Sammo Hung, who was honoured with the 42th Hong Kong Film Awards Lifetime Achievement Award for his contribution to the film industry for over half a century, has been active both on and off screen. Switching roles among action-choreographer, director, actor and all over on set, he consistently produces acclaimed film from time to time. In this episode, the 'Big Big Brother' will talk about his multiple roles in the field and struggle story of Sammo Hung Stunt Team.

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之西域雄獅
programme.desc: Wong Fei-hung, Clubfoot and 13th Aunt cross the Pacific Ocean to America to visit 'Bucktooth' So. While traveling through the wilderness, they pick up a cowboy named Billy..

programme.title: 神勇飛虎霸王花
programme.desc: Hong Kong's police force boasts of two of the world's finest anti-crime task forces-the Flying Tigers and the Banshees. After Madam Hu and her Banshees have put ringleaders of a notorious jewelry gang behind the bars, they return to routine training. New recruits to the Banshees – Joey, Phoebe, Ding and Susanna – soon blend themselves into the daily pursuit for tougher and fun. Lo, the anti-terrorist expert, is to inspect the Tigers and Banshees. A strengthened diet of training is introduced amid the moans and groans. Before long, the jewelry robbers escape to a deserted island. The Tigers and Banshees are ordered to capture them..

programme.title: 影人映語 -點解「吳式」笑 － 吳君如
programme.desc: Known as the 'Queen of Comedy', Sandra Ng as an actress has spanned across generations, allowing her to witness the ups and downs of Hong Kong films over decades. Looking back onto the golden age of Hong Kong cinema, Ng confessed that comedies in the old days were much more simple and straight forward. Stepping into the millennium, recession in film industry somehow inspired her to produce own masterpieces of the era. With her youth dedicated to the Hong Kong cinema, how does she feel about lifelong career as an actress, a director and a producer.

programme.title: 百變星君
programme.desc: Sing met Bonnie, a secret lover of a gang and is bombed for revenge. Only his mouth, brain and penis can still function. The doctor proposed the 'Sixty Million Dollar Man' plan..

programme.title: 上海假期
programme.desc: A 60-year-old retired teacher in Shanghai promises to look after his American-born grandson who comes to visit him for a short period. They experience the clash of cultures and the inevitable generation gap when getting along..

programme.title: 金像匠人: 天才與白痴
programme.desc: Our story begins in the Hang Seng Sanitarium, which has a quite amount of crazy people. Ah Tim is a handy man there and Li is a nurse. Ah Tim has the greatest enthusiasm in his work, especially when he combs through the remains of the deceased and divests them of worldly items like gold fillings. However, his enterprise is spotted by Li, therefore, he has to make it a profit sharing venture. Later on, with the arrival of old Cheng, big fortune comes too. The two is now planning seriously how to get all the valuables from the big guy. However..

programme.title: 求愛夜驚魂
programme.desc: Lung is a handsome young man. He has gift of the gab and is the best company to keep. Jane is a young talented reporter. She is devoted to her job. Lung and Jane seem to be ideally matched. But Jane, the famous TV reporter, has a lawyer boyfriend. And Lung is a mere taxi driver, just one of Jane's admirers. But Lung is determined to try. He gets to know Jane and gives her hot news tips. He organizes his cabbie friends into a radio news network, informing him all the happenings around the town. This works out at first, but sometimes they are led into ridiculous situation. Jane is slowly distancing herself form Lung. In desperation, Lung calls Jane saying he has the news of the century for her..

programme.title: 夜車
programme.desc: They are the generation who work hard at living it up at the discos, in midnight car races and occasional fight. They are not happy with the world they live in but are determined to make the most of it. They go racing down the freeway in a stolen car. When stopping at the petroleum station, they find they don't have money. On the spur of the moment, they decide to rob the station. After a fight, King Kong is badly hurt and Cream kills a staff by accident. Bee runs away from the group, badly shaken and frightened by this traumatic experience..

programme.title: 影人映語 -洪家班靠「搏」出位 – 洪金寶
programme.desc: In the last episode, Sammo Hung shared his story of being an action-choreographer, director and actor for over half a century in the film industry. Now he is going to talk more about apprenticeship with his master Yu Jim-yuen whom he learned the martial arts philosophy from and his journey of growing next-generation action stars; also give us an insight into the challenges towards Hong Kong action film nowadays.

programme.title: 最佳拍檔大顯神通
programme.desc: King Kong was attacked by the robot - Black Knight I which was sent by the Italian Mafia to avenge the capture of White Gloves. He also hired an internationally notorious killer Black Gloves to kill King Kong as well as diamond transfer deal with the underworld. King Kong join forces with the police to capture Black Gloves who sends Black Knight II to attack..
