programme.title: 龍虎風雲
programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat plays Ko Chow, a police undercover agent who is torn between his duty as a police officer and his loyalty to his friends on the wrong side of the law.

programme.title: 追鬼七雄
programme.desc: Long ago in China, corpses are supposed to be able to follow orders given by a leader and 'jump' to their respective burial places. However, some drug dealers use this method to smuggle opium. Things are going well until the local aristocrat, Master Miu, murders a singer's husband as he fails in attempting to rape her. He asks the corpse leader to take the body away. Then, one of the members from drug dealers is killed mysteriously. When the drug dealers try to go after the case, they find a strange corpse sucking in a huge snake in an old tower. Many members are killed as they try to get out in time..

programme.title: 八喜臨門
programme.desc: The Ng family: Doctor Ng, Mrs. Ng, Ng Chee, Ng Lei and Ng Choi went to picnic happily. Hereon, different romances happened between them: First of all, Lei was attracted by Macdonna, a very sexy girl; Chee loved little Rambo who saved her from two 'teddy' boys; Choi loved her elder cousin who was graduated from a foreign university and had not found a job yet; Mrs. Ng decided to apply for the post of actress for a drama association. Billy, the director of the drama was the divorced father of little Rambo. He fell in love with Mrs. Ng at the first sight..

programme.title: 決戰紫禁之巔
programme.desc: The story is set in the Ming dynasty. 'Holy Sword' requests a fight with secret agent 009's friend 'God of Sword' to decide the world's best swordsman. During the contest on the roof of the Forbidden City, 009 realises that 'Holy Sword' has sent a double to fight in his place, while he plans to assassinate the emperor. 'Holy Sword' finds himself surrounded by thousands of palace guards but is rescued by 'God of Sword', who wants to complete their championship..

programme.title: 流氓醫生
programme.desc: Dr. Mack Lau gives up his career in a famed hospital and opens a clinic in a run-down place. Not only does he heal the residences' wounds, but also their torn-and-broken hearts.

programme.title: 夜瘋狂
programme.desc: Teacher Wang is being held hostage one night by a bank robber in an all-night shop. Shop attendant Ling-ling and Wang struggle with the badly wounded robber, who dies in the fight. With two more accomplices, the four girls decide to destroy the body and split the $40 million the man has on him. But his gangs catch up with the girls and are about to rape and then kill them..

programme.title: 金像匠人: 龍的心
programme.desc: It's the two brothers of Hong Kong action as you have never seen them before in a gripping drama where the lines blur between family loyalty and upholding the law. Jackie Chan plays Ted, a SWAT officer with thwarted dreams of being a sailor because he has to look after his mentally disabled brother Danny. The resentment boils over in a terse showdown between the two brothers. When Danny accidentally ends up with a robbery loot while playing a harmless game of cops and robbers with his friends, Ted has to make an agonizing decision. Does he save the hapless Danny? Or arrest him.

programme.title: 老豆唔怕多
programme.desc: As with any other child of his age, seven-years-old Benny takes delight in getting into mischief and is a constant headache to his teachers and classmates. One day, his naughty ways finally led him into serious trouble. A list of triad members has fallen into his hands and he was kidnapped by the notorious gangsters. Thinking it was one of his usual pranks, his dad was undisturbed by Benny's sudden disappearance and made no attempt to trace his whereabouts. However, providence is on Benny's side for a policeman and a reporter are hot pursuit of him, as they both believed Benny to be their son..

programme.title: 最佳拍檔之千里救差婆
programme.desc: The invention of a prism - a special brain stimulant, gets King Kong and Inspector into a series of dangerous adventures. The lives of Inspector Ho and her son, Baldy Junior are also threatened by the villains..

programme.title: 影人映語 -詞「得」達意 - 黎彼得
programme.desc: Although a lot of people recognize Peter Lai mostly from his TV drama's performance, he is arguably one of the veteran lyricists in Hong Kong music industry. Looking back from ‘Choi San Dou' to ‘Monica', his lyrics have definitely contributed the success of numerous well-known immortals. Why would he become an actor while debuted as a lyricist? Worked with so many famous stars, what related interesting stories he is going to reveal to us.

programme.title: 警察故事III
programme.desc: Detective Chan is recruited by Interpol to infiltrate the operations of a drug lord. He is forced to survive with his wits and courage during the most dangerous mission.

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之二男兒當自強
programme.desc: During his stay in Canton, Wong Fei Hung meets Sun Yat Sun and Luke. He decides to help them escape by the 'cover' from the rioting White Lotus Sect.

programme.desc: In the last episode, Sammo Hung shared his story of being an action-choreographer, director and actor for over half a century in the film industry. Now he is going to talk more about apprenticeship with his master Yu Jim-yuen whom he learned the martial arts philosophy from and his journey of growing next-generation action stars; also give us an insight into the challenges towards Hong Kong action film nowadays.

programme.title: 霸王花
programme.desc: Police Superintendent Wu is in charged with the duty of organizing Hong Kong's first all women police action squad. At first, her style of training is too harsh for the girls who are used to dates and dances. She is able to gain their respect and obedience eventually. The leader of the men's squad, Kan, falls for Wu and he has the most hilarious way of showing his love towards her. Wu's top shooter and fighter help her give the girls some fine tuning such as walking on fire. Their first real assignment finally arrives when they, along with the men's squad, are sent to guard a jewelry exhibition. The robbers capture both Wu and Kan in a shoot-out..

programme.title: 與龍共舞
programme.desc: Aaron, a young, successful Chinese businessman, drifts on to a rural island after a scuba accident. Mistaken for an illegal immigrant, he is forced to take refuge in a small, family-run grocery store. Enjoying the riches to rags transition, he tells nobody his true identity, and falls in love with the grocery store owner's daughter, Yvonne. But while Aaron enjoys his life of anonymity, Yvonne covets the chance to escape her poverty.

programme.title: 幻影特攻
programme.desc: Two CIA researchers undergo 'VR Fighter training' in order to save a kidnapped colleague. The training is designed to change an unskilled agent into a magnificent combat agent.

programme.title: 衛斯理藍血人
programme.desc: Wesley is a member of the United Nation Aliens Analyzing Agency, and no stranger to extraterrestrial sightings. This time he finds himself face to face with Fong, a blue-blooded alien stranded on earth. Wesley and his girlfriend So promise to help Fong, but they must first combat FBI's powerful X Unit, who intends to capture Fong for their experiments. Making matters worse is the arrival of two aliens from Fong's home planet, determined to kill anyone that prevents them from retrieving their own species..

programme.title: 金像匠人: 猛鬼差館
programme.desc: A Hong Kong police station used to be a clubhouse of the Japanese at the time of their occupation of the city during World War II. However, at the end of the war, many of the Japanese committed haka-kiri in the clubhouse. In the present time, after thief Sneaky Ming was captured and incarcerated at the station, he was lured into a world of the paranormal by the spirits of those still inhabiting the building. He was tricked into unleashing the fierce General Issei, who resurrects into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the city. As a result, police officers Kam Mark-K and Man-Chill attempt to put a stop to the terror.

programme.title: 亡命鴛鴦
programme.desc: Crack policeman Hsiang Ming is having a talk with his separated wife when a bullet from hired killer Ah Chui kills the wife, an anti-drug policewoman. Hsiang Ming goes after the killer but is told to keep off by senior officer Lu. In fact, Lu is head of a narcotics ring and lover of Hsiang Ming's ex-wife. She knows his secret, thus Lu hires Ah Chui to kill her. Then Lu sets about to kill every one connected with crime-the go-between and Ah Chui. On his death bed, the go-between tells Hsiang Ming where to find Ah Chui. This Hsiang Ming does. But Lu's men are coming to kill both of them. Hsiang Ming has to fight off the attackers. Hsiang Ming takes Ah Chui to his mother-in-law's house where Ah Chui meets Hsiang Ming's daughter and feels shameful. When Lu's men come, she saves the young girl and an injured Hsiang Ming. As Hsiang Ming's friends fail to stop Lu, Ah Chui takes Hsiang Ming to a secret hide out and nurses him. They become lovers..

programme.title: 警察故事III
programme.desc: Detective Chan is recruited by Interpol to infiltrate the operations of a drug lord. He is forced to survive with his wits and courage during the most dangerous mission.

programme.title: 最佳拍檔之千里救差婆
programme.desc: The invention of a prism - a special brain stimulant, gets King Kong and Inspector into a series of dangerous adventures. The lives of Inspector Ho and her son, Baldy Junior are also threatened by the villains..

programme.title: 影人映語 -型「德」起！ - 王敏德
programme.desc: Michael Wong rose to prominence on the big screen in the 80s with his “half Chinese, half foreign' identity and eye-catching appearance, from the early rebellious and unruly big boy to the tough and strong policeman role later. Looking back the bygone days, he barely knew Cantonese but was fortunate to meet a like-minded partner who helped him through the break-in period, and which film from his decades-long career impressed him the most? After played countless roles, how does he feel about his identity as an actor.

programme.title: 霸王花
programme.desc: Police Superintendent Wu is in charged with the duty of organizing Hong Kong's first all women police action squad. At first, her style of training is too harsh for the girls who are used to dates and dances. She is able to gain their respect and obedience eventually. The leader of the men's squad, Kan, falls for Wu and he has the most hilarious way of showing his love towards her. Wu's top shooter and fighter help her give the girls some fine tuning such as walking on fire. Their first real assignment finally arrives when they, along with the men's squad, are sent to guard a jewelry exhibition. The robbers capture both Wu and Kan in a shoot-out..

programme.title: 猛鬼差館
programme.desc: A Hong Kong police station used to be a clubhouse of the Japanese at the time of their occupation of the city during World War II. However, at the end of the war, many of the Japanese committed haka-kiri in the clubhouse. In the present time, after thief Sneaky Ming was captured and incarcerated at the station, he was lured into a world of the paranormal by the spirits of those still inhabiting the building. He was tricked into unleashing the fierce General Issei, who resurrects into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the city. As a result, police officers Kam Mark-K and Man-Chill attempt to put a stop to the terror.

programme.title: 皇家戰士
programme.desc: When a Hong Kong policewoman, a Japanese Interpol agent and an air security officer botch a plane hijacking attempt by a militia fanatic, his veteran friends vow revenge. In order to stop the terrorist attacks and also to save their own lives, the three heroes must team up once again to fight their gun-toting adversaries.

programme.title: 名劍
programme.desc: Swords, like diamonds, sometimes carry a curse. And the famous sword Chi Mud is such a sword. When swordmaster Wah acquires Chi Mud, he is advised to destroy it or he will be killed by this very sword. Wah does not listen. He has already retired into seclusion and does not think the young swordsmen can find and challenge him. Li is such a young swordsman. He even has dueled and killed another young challenger. Li by accident saves a young girl from a professional killer. In a few days, the girl and Li become friends. But the girl leaves in anger when Li meets his old flame Hsiao Yue, now married to Lin Wan. Li is ambushed by killer Chan..

programme.title: 特警新人類
programme.desc: To fight against the new era criminals, Inspector Chan struggles for picking up a group of brand new cadets to become his new team called the 'Gen-X-Cops'..

programme.title: 小男人周記
programme.desc: Leung Foon is one of those youthful, upward-moving people. He is 33, middle rung officer of an advertising agency, and has been married eight years to Ann. Ann holds down a key post in a finance company. She also likes to manage Foon's life. The couple has been drifting apart. A quarrel and the two decide to separate. Q-Taro and Big Cheat, Foon's colleagues and close friends, like to fool around. Q is married to the city shrew while Big Cheat's wife puts him above everything else. Foon has a new boss, Mrs. Lam who wants to rid the agency of useless employees. She forces Foon to fire Q-Taro..

programme.title: 影人映語 -電影旦—鄭丹瑞
programme.desc: Lawrence Cheng has been working in the film industry over 40 years who was known with his friends in the 1980s as the creator of The Yuppie Fantasia franchise. In this episode, Cheng shares his motive of creation and key to success of such franchise, as well as how he got obsessed with film as teen. Looking back, he admits that he was not a very competent director and reveals more unforgettable stories of the past.

programme.title: 急凍奇俠
programme.desc: Yuen Biao and Yuen Wah are two Ming Dynasty adversaries who topple into an ice chasm, only to be thawed out in modern day Hong Kong.

programme.title: 望夫成龍
programme.desc: Shek Kam Shui eloped to the city with his lover Ng Dai Tai. He becomes a diamond sales and was appraised by his senior, Nancy which finally destroys his marriage..

programme.desc: Phillip Wong, a colour-blind dance instructor who is devoted to the Japanese Para Para. He meets Yee, a spoiled rich girl and an attraction begins to form between the two..

programme.title: 壞女孩
programme.desc: The first thing on notices about Yau is his strong hatred for mahjong. He had good reasons: his mahjong-playing mother refused to leave the gaming table to attend to his father who had been robbed. The father died as the result, of course. Being young and fancy-free, Yau goes to the beach with two friends to see if romance should drop on him. It does, and like a ton of bricks because he sees and falls for the beautiful Fong. It so happen Fong is a devoted mahjong player, but she has a sister who hates mahjong, Yau goes all out. He is first snubbed but later comforted by Fong in a gymnasium where he helps her dodge arresting traffic policemen. Fong tries her best to cover her addiction to mahjong and awkward situations come on fast and furious..

Back in Hong Kong, a Secret Service man from the Bond Street Headquarters, Mr. Tom Collins, has just arrived to find out a gang of notorious international crooks led by Mr. Bond. Carried out his mission successfully for Mr. Bond, King Kong is summoned by the Governor to assist Collins in retrieving the stolen goods and catch Mr. Bond's gang.

programme.desc: Yan always sees dead people. Jim, her psychologist, thinks it's all in her mind brought by loneliness and by unpleasant experiences of past relationships. He devotes all his time to curing her. Jim soon falls in love as Yan is freed of her vision. But then he starts seeing dead people too. Jim remembers his past. His girlfriend in high school, named Yu, committed suicide when Jim tried to break up with her in twenty years ago. Now, with Yan's help and love, can Jim face up to the ghost and end the nightmare.

Nine agrees to set the ghosts free but warns Ming that he must part ways with them, but Ta Pao is captured by Devil Lady later due to Chiang's act of mischief..

That leaves Tsung-pao, the youngest son, and four daughters. They are all police officers. What makes the mother prouder is Tsung-pao's marrying a senior policewoman Mina. Old Mrs. Huang is hoping to see a grandson to carry on the lawmen family tree. But the sisters don't like Mina. They make sure she does not have a good time. Mina suffers in silence. A raid on a Vietnamese gang was ordered. Tsung-pao and Mina to command. But sister Ling commits a serious mistake and the whole operation fails. Ling is suspended. She blames it on Mina..

programme.title: 衛斯理之霸王卸甲
programme.desc: This is a film about one of the practical metaphysics of the Orient - Geomancy. The Orientals believe fervently that a good burial site endows fame and fortune on its descendants. When the story begins, two geomancers are roaming Indochina's wilderness trying to find the dream grave site. They find The Conqueror, a site generating wealth and power - also a bloodbath. Nguen wants it but Wei wants no bloodbath. They have a fight. Wei escapes by the skin of his teeth. Wei rewards the poor man who saved him by finding him a good grave site. Many years later, Anna who is believed to be the daughter of the poor man, heads an American computer empire. Wei's son, Wisely, is a famous traveler. The girl asks him to go to Indochina to trace their roots..

Seasonal is making his debut as Soo's special guest in a reading-concert, his avant-garde style is badly received, only Moth supports him whole heatedly. Not long afterwards the two get married, and only until then Seasonal realizes that he has married to a roaring lion who limits him on all his activities and expenses..

After spending so many years involving with vice and crime, he was sick of this world and wanted to start his life anew. Some ten years ago, Chai had two side-kicks, Tang Kar Yung and Chan Ting Kok. Kok was adopted by Uncle Cut, the father of Yung. The two boys were raised up together and they were like brothers, if not by blood. When Bill went for an audition at the TV station, he ran into his ex-girlfriend and got himself into trouble when his wife thought he was having an affair. Mother's earnest wish is to find a wife for Sam Fat to continue the family tree. Teacher Cheung, along with six of his students arrive on the island for camping. They first meet Yee Fat who brings them to the grocery for a rest. Yee Fat is delighted with the presence of the 3 young girls while Sam Fat falls in love at first sight with the charming girl Phyllis. He expresses his feelings to Tai Fat who has sworn to his mother that he will fulfill her wish to find his youngest brother a wife. He proposes to Cheung that Phyllis be married to Sam Fat. To save Tai's life, Cheung attacks Song and not only leaves a scar on Song's face, but also puts him in jail for five years which plants a seed of the revenge five years later. Form that moment, the only person that can cheer him up is his best girl friend Ruby. Yet, Cheung has his heart on Sandy, a young solicitor who helped set him free in an assault case. programme.title: Recipe For Love
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第1季
programme.desc: Tensions reach boiling point as the celebrities face their toughest challenge yet. First, they navigate a powerful river to reach their camp, where they must build shelters and catch their supper without the usual army rations in sight. Then, a tropical storm strikes and water begins to flood the base, making for their worst night so far. The next morning, the contestants have to call on their newly acquired knot-tying skills to transform two unstable canoes into a catamaran and travel across to an island two miles away.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第1季
programme.desc: As the remaining six celebrities pass the halfway point of the 12-day mission, they are starting to toughen up, but with one suffering from mosquito bites and another requiring treatment for trench foot, life in the jungle is beginning to take its toll. Arriving at a two-mile cave system, the contestants have to eat tarantulas' legs for breakfast, before using their rope skills to navigate the tight spaces and waterfall descents ahead, keeping a lookout for snakes, bats - and their dinner, a fresh pig carcass that Bear has hidden somewhere in the cave.

programme.title: Space Farmers 第1季
programme.desc: Space foods, initially created just for astronauts, has now facilitated a revolution in agricultural and alternative food production. This revolution is changing the way we think about producing food in the future. In Finland, protein-rich foods are produced from thin air, making food production possible in a variety of environments, including deserts, cities, and even outer space. Scientists in the United States are working to make mushroom cultivation more sustainable, while in Austria, seeds are exposed to space radiation to improve their yield when grown back on Earth. A startup in Singapore is using space technology to enhance the security of livestock herds, and at NUS, a team has developed a remarkable hydrogel that makes crop cultivation more water-efficient.

programme.title: Space Farmers 第1季
programme.sub-title: Food For Space Helps Planet Earth
programme.desc: How will research to live in space in the future benefit us on Earth today? In the Netherlands, we meet a team of researchers working with Martian and Lunar soil to grow crops and mealworms as food. In Thailand, scientists test the effects of varying gravity on the next superfood - watermeal. Meanwhile, an astounding transformation of agriculture is underway in Australia, with crop cultivation methods increasing output by 100%. With a cultivated beef firm in Israel racing to grow meat in space and a Singaporean company using microalgae to produce protein-rich foods, we learn how less is more for food production. Inspired by the similarity between disaster areas and outer space, a Japanese entrepreneur creates jellies to provide nutrition to earthquake victims and astronauts. As the space industry in Singapore grows, collaborations between countries and students’ interests in outer space deepen, leading to a transformation in space-for-humanity research.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -資源回收大盜
programme.desc: Addison and her friends are distracted from their mission of making cool costumes for Ayrton Park's version of Comicon when someone or something starts messing with recycling bins all over the neighbourhood.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -失蹤的無齒翼龍之謎
programme.desc: When an inflatable Pteranodon goes missing from the roof of Pizzamat, Addison and Alex are on the case to find it.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -迴紋針
programme.desc: Nothing is too boring for Hepi and Briko. Watch them make fun things with paperclips.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -壞掉的雨傘
programme.desc: Watch Hepi and Brigo give umbrellas a second life with these fascinating ideas.

programme.title: 優可 -維克跟別人玩
programme.desc: When Mai and Oto get jealous of Vik's other friends, they finally realise it's possible to make new friends and keep the old ones too.

programme.title: 藝術忍者 -間諜日
programme.desc: Ricky's always wanted to be a spy, but when he starts receiving mysterious phone calls full of code words, he is not so sure anymore. He makes a secret book and selfie collage inspired by David Hockney and agrees to a rendezvous at the Tate Modern.

programme.title: 藝術忍者 -祖先日
programme.desc: Ricky researches his family history to uncover his ninja ancestors. Inspired by Grayson Perry, he makes an autobiographical vase and a photo frame and discovers that he is descended from a famous pirate.

programme.title: 探討有趣新發明 -寫程式的女孩
programme.desc: Host Alie Ward presents a former politician who is teaching girls to code, a fold-up kayak, headlights for running shoes,and a woman who invented a new way to keep food fresh.

programme.title: 探討有趣新發明 -滅雷無人機
programme.desc: Host Alie Ward presents artistic globes of the world, health devices made from toys, a drone that finds and clears landmines, and a man building mansions in trees.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -一切的開端, 下集
programme.desc: The children arrive at the Meteo Expert Center. They are excited but also a little unsure of what to expect. Margherita Rita explains to them how the kids can use their superpowers in the fight against climate change and save the environment.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -蜜蜂求救
programme.desc: Someone's been spraying toxic pesticides on crops. That is hurting all the bees, and they are in dire need of help. If the bees die, so will all the flowers and plants that they pollinate! It's time for the MeteoHeroes to save the day.

programme.title: 地球小尖兵 -環境行動主義者
programme.desc: Kids meet an environmental activist.

programme.title: 打造貓樂園 -貓計程車
programme.desc: OEistein makes a cardboard cat taxi.

programme.title: 全球探險家霍吉 -霍吉去舊金山
programme.desc: The friends travel to foggy San Francisco and land on Jonah's picnic basket. They offer to help fix the mistake. But some confusion with directions takes Lorna and Bernie on a different path to Hogie and Jonah. The gang wonders if they will ever find each other again.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -南瓜與巨龍
programme.desc: Rose accidentally turns Regal Academy into a pumpkin patch. The teachers need a rare colossal pumpkin to reverse the spell. With help from Alicia, Puss In Boots' granddaughter, Rose, Hawk, and the others must find the rare pumpkin to save the school.

programme.title: 神奇小百科 -黏菌會思考嗎
programme.desc: Slime mould are cleverer than they look even though they don't have eyes, a skeleton, a nervous system, or even a brain. They are single-celled organisms. There are more than 900 species of them all over the world.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -沿岸沙漠
programme.desc: Four young adventurers explore Namaqua National Park in South Africa, a desert region with the largest concentration of succulent plants in the world. They learn how to survive in its harsh environment by learning ancient traditions.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -沙漠花開
programme.desc: Four young adventurers discover how plants, animals and people survive in the harsh desert environment of Namaqua National Park in South Africa. The short rainy season has started and the desert is in full bloom.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -洛基的城堡
programme.desc: The Nektons take over the Dark Orca submarine. But the pirates take over the Aronnax. No one is happy with having strangers in their homes.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -烏龜
programme.desc: The Nektons explore a floating island and find the pieces of the ancient Lemurian navigation device. But why is this island moving.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -宮廷愛情
programme.desc: Dove is going through a rocky time with her horrible husband, Lord Roach. She consequently falls for Sir Howler. Despite being humble and loyal, Howler isn't always a paragon of finesse when it comes to winning the lady's heart or dealing with the jealous spouse.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -煉金術
programme.desc: Welcome to the world of medieval alchemy, introduced by our mad scientist friend, Howler! He's looking for a way to transmute lead into gold: it's the only way to escape insatiable Lord Roach's fort as the greedy noble seeks to increase his fortune.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -智力升級
programme.desc: The principal warns: fail the next exam, and you're out. Everyone worries about Flippy. Carol wants to tutor him, Robbie plans to steal the test, Naomi suggests a nerd disguise, Jessi bakes brain cookies, and Motor builds a genius cap-but smart Flippy isn't so nice.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -娜歐蜜的生日
programme.desc: Naomi's birthday is coming, and she's planned it all-including the pricey gift her friends must buy. To afford it, Albert writes homework, Carol babysits, Flippy dances, and Robbie... borrows from Naomi! But will the gift-and the party-be all she hoped for.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -髒兮兮
programme.desc: Sir Howler is expecting a visit from the king any second! Only problem is, the town where he lives is a total garbage dump! So the Little Urchins get to work to make the place look spic and span, demonstrating the spectrum of medieval cleaning techniques.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -奇妙醫學和急救
programme.desc: What's the best way to organise a first aid kit? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of medicine. Have hands-on fun by making a handy first aid kit, and get to know Al-Zahrawi, ‘the father of surgery' & inventor of a number of surgical instruments.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -磁鐵的多項應用
programme.desc: How did people know where they were heading before GPS? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of magnetism. Have hands-on fun by constructing your own compass, and get to know An Wang, a computer engineer who revolutionised magnetic core memory.

programme.title: 優可 -人人為我, 我為人人
programme.desc: Each of the kids wants to play a different game, but when the competition gets too fierce, they must use teamwork to play together.

programme.title: 優可 -陰天
programme.desc: Chaos erupts in the park when Yoko turns clouds into real animals, and the kids must plan how to return things to normal.

programme.title: 和格林韋德一家環保生活 -修理舊物品
programme.desc: Join the Grimwade family as they save the planet by going green. When the youngest family member starts sitting up, it's time to think about moving baby Houston to a cot. But the old one is dirty and worn. Which of the 5 R's should they use today.

programme.title: 和格林韋德一家環保生活 -重複使用舊衣服
programme.desc: The Grimwades are going green. They're also growing up fast, which leaves them with a problem. What should they do with their old clothes? Especially when they're too good to be thrown away.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -熔巖燈
programme.desc: You'll lava this one. We'll show you how to use a bottle and oil in this make that bubbles and boils.

programme.title: 優可 -鬧雙包
programme.desc: The kids see themselves in a new light and discover the errors of their ways when Yoko creates magical doppelgangers of them.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -跳躍蜘蛛
programme.desc: Bouncing beetles or leaping ladybugs. You can make any jumping insect you like. We'll show you how to make a spider with serious spring.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -冰島之旅
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo are playing a game that uses family names. Alim joins them, but it turns out that he doesn't have a surname. And he is far from being the only one. Our heroes will probably understand this better if they visit Alim's penfriend Gunnar in Iceland.

programme.title: 小小致富夢想家 -天使投資者
programme.desc: Max gets a sponsor, but his investment comes with his meddling daughter, who takes over the group. The gang shows her she doesn't need to buy friends.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -嘴巴與膝蓋的對決
programme.desc: The doctors investigate which part of the body heals the fastest, the mouth or the knee. And in the emergency department, Sophie has a screw in her foot.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -堅固的液體
programme.desc: Eric learns that although all matter in the universe exists in three main states – solid, liquid and gas – it's also possible to create a liquid that acts like a solid. He does an experiment to create this substance, called Oobleck.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -你的身體主要由水組成
programme.desc: Did you know you're mostly made of water? Find out how as the doctors say hello to your hypothalamus - the amazing part of your brain that keeps you hydrated.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -刺激的聲音
programme.desc: Eric learns how sound waves work in the air and in water. Then he does an experiment to make sound waves travel along a piece of string.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -間諜視覺

programme.title: 深海大探險 -入口

programme.desc: Daisy, the donkey, has a painful eye that needs sorting out. The Junior Vets give hungry hippos Ernie and Godzilla a dental check and find out if George the giraffe has any unwelcome guests.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -童年
programme.desc: Children of noble stock receive an education in a castle environment while peasant offspring spend their youth working in the fields or at home. Daily life is busy, from a very young age. But kids never forget to have fun and goof around or playing pranks on each other.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -貝殻衫神木

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -物體的重量

programme.desc: Eric learns that neurons are the brain's tiny building blocks. He does an experiment to show what they are and how they work. He is surprised to learn that giraffes have neurons that are five metres long.

programme.desc: When Max is left alone with Goliath and their babysitter, Teresa gives him three simple rules: don't let Goliath hear organ music, smell 'chicken smoke,' or see the full moon through food, or there'll be terrible consequences.

programme.title: 動物電視台 -野兔
programme.desc: Tiny Owl is trying to explain the differences between hares and rabbits to Mommy and Daddy. Fiona Fox is engrossed in the hares on TV, and Franky has everybody in the Fox household in hysterics laughing at his terrible hare jokes.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -紙飛機起飛臺
programme.desc: Take flight with this marvellous make that is just plane fun.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -水晶洞穴
programme.desc: When Oto shares his homemade rock candy, the Team sees an odd similarity between the candy and a picture of giant crystals in Oto's rock book. It sounds crazy, but are those giant crystals candy? They set off to Chihuahua, Mexico, to find out.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -天靈靈多奇靈靈
programme.desc: When amateur magician Doki accidentally makes Gabi's worm vanish, Gabi is in a panic. How can they bring Lancelot back? To find out, Team Doki travels to a magic show in Las Vegas, Nevada to ask for help from a real magician named The Fantabulous Fenn.

programme.desc: Space tourism is becoming a common occurrence, thanks to the efforts of Blue Origin. Host Emily Calandrelli takes a look at some moments with a “big impact” in the space industry today.

programme.desc: Xploration Outer Space has over 75 episodes, and host Emily Calandrelli has been there every step of way. In this special episode, Emily recalls some of her favorite moments, ranging from cutting edge science to adventures with our #StudentAstronaut contest winners.

programme.desc: It's poptastic! The doctors put your acoustic reflex to the test with an enormous balloon. And a serious case of snotting awaits the loser of today's Ouchology.

programme.title: 體操新星 -永遠相信自己
programme.desc: Finally, it's competition time for the Acro gymnasts as they head off to Liverpool for the British Championships. Harry and George hope to make a great impression, and superstar choreographer Andrew has been called in to fine-tune the boys' performance.

programme.desc: In this episode of Becoming Xtraordinary presented by Bear Grylls, tennis legend, French Open, and Grand Slam winner, Roger Federer, and the world's most successful woman in Indy car racing, Danica Patrick, share their stories on becoming the best in the world.

programme.desc: Eric learns that, with a little science, you can bring out all the colours that make up the black ink in felt tip markers. He separates the colours using chromatography. This gives him a way to write secret messages.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -孤注一擲
programme.desc: It's a busy week for our Ice Stars. Charlie and Freddie have tryouts for a different sort of ice sport. Meanwhile, the Icicles are taking a break from their busy schedule and having some fun off the ice. And Asiyah is waiting for an important call.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -壯觀的病菌
programme.desc: Eric discovers that washing your hands can prevent the spread of bacteria. He does an experiment to show how easy it is to spread these tiny germs from person to person.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -新名字
programme.desc: Can the Junior Vets determine the sex of a very special penguin? Six cute kittens need checkups and new names - meet X-ray, Smudge, and, of course, baby Johnny! And Paul, the rat, has trouble breathing.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -這裡有龍
programme.desc: A dragon-hunting expedition leads Ant to find an ancient scroll that holds clues to an amazing mystery.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -從嘴到胃
programme.desc: The doctors demonstrate how the mouth, nose and stomach are all connected. Dr. Xand visits a freezing room and Dr. Chris meets a robot surgeon. In the emergency room at the hospital, one patient has a stone in his ear and another has a broken elbow.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -自畫像
programme.desc: This episode shows how an artist can determine the accurate placement of eyes, ears, nose, chin, and lips on portraits by using proportions. We show you how you can do the same by just using a string and applying some rules about the human body.

programme.title: 體操新星 -真摯友誼
programme.desc: Best friends Talia and Theo are getting prepared for the British Trampoline Championships. Talia takes Theo to the funfair to help take his mind off his worries before the big event.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -露比的臭腳
programme.desc: The Junior Vets are on the farm, hoping to discover some pregnant cows. Poor Fern, the lurcher, has been abandoned and needs a new home. Ruby, the lamb, has a smelly infected foot, and Johnny and Inel meet a dog who likes to join the family for dinner.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -解題關鍵
programme.desc: Say what?! This episode focuses on the importance of reading math problems very carefully in order to fully understand the problem at hand. Because if you don't answer the right question, how can the solution ever be right.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -來抓我
programme.desc: Today, the Junior Vets meet some feisty meerkats who need their claws trimmed, but first, they've got to catch them. Ashanti, the elephant, gets his feet and tail cleaned. Johnny and Inel discover what you get when you cross a lion and a tiger.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -配對襪子
programme.desc: In this episode we explain the concept of 'probability'. How can we weigh all our possibilities to eventually pick the most likely outcome? In order to illustrate our options, Eric rearranges his messy sock drawer – blindfolded.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -奇異果山谷救援小隊
programme.desc: When one of their friends gets hurt, Darwin and Newts form the Kiwifruit Valley Rescue Team to help in an emergency.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -黑妮的雞舍
programme.desc: When Heni's new chickens take over her garden, Darwin and Newts come up with a plan to keep everyone happy.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -密度強度
programme.desc: Eric uses a magic trick to show how density causes some things to float and others to sink to the bottom. He mixes different substances in an easy experiment.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -貓熊與金剛鸚鵡
programme.desc: Posse, the red panda, and Santiago, the saki, have been having issues with their teeth and the dentist brought his big pliers! Ever heard the tale of how the blue-throated macaw parrot was saved from extinction and started a new fashion trend in the process.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -視線錯覺, 我的眼睛
programme.desc: Eric is fooled by an optical illusion with three lines. Then he draws a goldfish and a bowl and sticks them to a pencil to create his own optical illusion.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -虎鯨寶寶
programme.desc: Morgan, the deaf orca, is about to give birth to her very first calf. The stakes are high, and the staff at Loro Parque are holding their collective breath as the scene is set for the greatest natural phenomenon in the zoo's history.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -瓶中龍捲風
programme.desc: Eric pretends to be a tornado. He finds out they happen when the wind starts rotating really fast in a vortex – a whirlpool shape. Then he learns how to make a tornado using recycled plastic bottles.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -艾瑞克製造風
programme.desc: Eric learns that an anemometer – an instrument to measure wind speed – is important for sailors and for pilots. Then he learns how to make one himself.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -希望與夢想
programme.desc: The Icicles have made it to the World Synchro Championships and are heading to Canada. After a season of flawless performances, can the girls pull off their Bollywood routine? The end of season Gala is near, but preparations aren't running as smoothly as everyone hoped.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -宴會時間

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -沙漠花開
programme.desc: Four young adventurers discover how plants, animals and people survive in the harsh desert environment of Namaqua National Park in South Africa. The short rainy season has started and the desert is in full bloom.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -國王企鵝
programme.desc: Annabelle, the king penguin, is displaying some worrying symptoms. She's waving her head about skywards and Jorge is concerned she may have some neurological problems. Will Annabelle rejoin her friends on the great, icy mound at Loro Parque ever again.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -烏龜菲德莉卡
programme.desc: Federica, the turtle, has arrived from Italy after a run-in with a container ship. Loro Parque has offered to be her ‘forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? Esmeralda, the iguana, has a lumpy belly and Jorge, the vet, is worried.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -中國之旅
programme.desc: Zoe is writing a card to a friend but is afraid of making spelling mistakes. Is there a country in this world with no spelling rules at all? To find out, our friends travel to China, where people don't use letters but ideograms.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -墨西哥之旅

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -巴布亞紐幾內亞之旅
programme.desc: Milo battles with mosquitoes using an insecticide spray but realises he can't win. Our heroes decide to pay a visit to their penfriend in Papua New Guinea and learn how to co-exist alongside mosquitoes.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -殭屍化
programme.desc: Motor creates a new computer game whose addictiveness threatens the productivity of the entire world.

programme.desc: When crop circles begin appearing in Ayrton Park, Alex suspects visitors from the fourth dimension, but Addison begins sleuthing in search of a different explanation.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -蒙蒂休假日
programme.desc: How could we have superpowers? The team flies off to Germany, to borrow some high-tech ‘super' suits. They try using a climbing suit, a jet pack and a powerlifting suit, but none is able to recover the Frisbee.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -塑膠杯
programme.desc: What could we make with a paper cup? Let's find out.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -罐頭
programme.desc: Tin Tin Tin, Hepi and Briko have an unbelievable idea for these tin cans.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -拉法的一天
programme.desc: Meet the Loro Parque Foundation Scientific Director - Rafa, also known as the ‘Birdman of Loro Parque'. He wears the badge with pride and every day he surrounds himself with all things ornithological - from parrots and puffins to penguins.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -大猩猩醫腳
programme.desc: Ubongo, the gorilla, has a massive cut on his foot. But how do you treat a 400-pound gorilla with a sore foot? And have you ever seen a sloth take a shower? Hugo, the sloth, will draw back the shower curtain and reveal all.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -煉金術
programme.desc: Welcome to the world of medieval alchemy, introduced by our mad scientist friend, Howler! He's looking for a way to transmute lead into gold: it's the only way to escape insatiable Lord Roach's fort as the greedy noble seeks to increase his fortune.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -宮廷愛情
programme.desc: Dove is going through a rocky time with her horrible husband, Lord Roach. She consequently falls for Sir Howler. Despite being humble and loyal, Howler isn't always a paragon of finesse when it comes to winning the lady's heart or dealing with the jealous spouse.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -騎士們
programme.desc: Little Lewis follows every step in order to achieve his dream. After completing a plethora of thankless tasks at a young age, he moves on to the rank of ‘squire.' A chance to demonstrate his bravery on the battlefield, in order to be knighted, at last.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -隱藏寶石之謎
programme.desc: When Addison and Tess find a note in a funny old pair of rummage sale pants, they think they may have found a clue to lead them to a stash of priceless hidden diamonds.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -壞女孩一號偵探社之謎
programme.desc: When the school mean girls, Katie and Dinara, start their own detective agency and solve a rash of neighbourhood mysteries before Addison can, she wonders if she's lost her touch...or if there is something else more nefarious going on.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -松果
programme.desc: Creativity has no limits! Watch Hepi and Briko transform these cones into something lovely.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -塑膠湯匙
programme.desc: Hepi and Briko reuse spoons to make some cute DIY's.

programme.title: 優可 -顏色
programme.desc: The kids have to learn about compromise when they try to decide what colour to paint a birdhouse: yellow, red, or blue.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -釣魚之旅
programme.desc: Senior comes to Sprinter's house to invite him on a fishing trip. Sprinter wants to catch some flying fish, but Senior is hunting for the mythical cloud whale, which is said to be impossible to catch.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -里歐堅硬的外表
programme.desc: Leo feels sad because she's smaller than everyone else. Sprinter builds her a robot making her as tall as him. But is everything going to be easier when you're as tall as everyone else, or is it better to be the size that you're.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -風暴與海浪
programme.desc: Surfing the waves leads Kit and Mr. Battery into a dangerous storm.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -最大的動物
programme.desc: Mr. Battery collects photos of the largest animals, but he's still missing a photo of the mysterious giant squid.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -荷蘭之旅
programme.desc: On which day in December should people receive their presents? Zoe and Milo are sure that it should be on Christmas, but Alim explains that in some countries, this happens on December 6th. They travel to the Netherlands and learn the story of St. Nicholas.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -西藏之旅
programme.desc: Zoe has started to make a mandala and she needs Milo's beautiful colouring pencils to finish it. That is not a problem for Milo, except that his pencil box is empty! How can Zoe finish her mandala without colouring pencils? A trip to Tibet soon appears to be necessary.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -布吉納法索之旅
programme.desc: In Burkina Faso, our heroes' penfriend Jamal can't wait to introduce Zoe and Milo to his parents, and like Alim, he appears to have several mums and dads. What a mystery.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -沙烏地阿拉伯之旅
programme.desc: Our heroes travel to Saudi Arabia and meet up with Ahed. He knows different ways to move in the desert by day and night, but what he does not know is where his goats have gone. He is going to need some help from his friends.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -多奇探險隊的大冒險
programme.desc: While practicing some circus-style tricks, team Doki gets an idea to put on a real circus show for all their friends of the Worldwide Expedition Club. Doki wants it to be amazing, so they set off to a real circus to find out how to put on the Greatest Show on Earth.

programme.title: 叢林樂節拍 -刺蝟--地底深處
programme.desc: The hedgehog has dug a beautiful hole. Lovely, except that he made it so deep that he can not climb out. He creates an escape tunnel, but it only takes him further and further away. Welcome to the jungle where funny animals live and play.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -電流力學
programme.desc: How do batteries work? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of electricity. Have hands-on fun by making a battery using lemons, and get to know Nikola Tesla, physicist, engineer and inventor, who conceived the modern alternating current supply system.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -環保科學和回收
programme.desc: What's the difference between science and green science? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of renewable energy. Have hands-on fun by making your lettuce sustainable, and get to know Ryoji Noyori, a chemist and great advocate of green chemistry.

programme.title: 44隻貓 -皮露鬆動的牙齒
programme.desc: Pilou notices she has a loose tooth and she's a bit scared: she doesn't want to touch it because she's afraid it could be painful! Isotta calms her down and suggests her to visit her kitten Mimi, the pediatrician cat.

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -愛波的冬日大衣
programme.desc: Granny has knitted an orange and purple striped coat for Ebb. Flo takes Ebb for a beach walk in the new coat. But it's too hot. Ebb takes a dip. Ebb's coat stretches and stretches. Ebb and Bird find they have a new orange and purple winter blanket.

programme.title: 百變小露露 -美麗的土星環
programme.desc: Looking through the telescope, Jupiter spots Saturn and its rings. Can you walk on them? Luna, Jupiter, and Clyde turn into planets to find out.

programme.title: 留校察看大冒險 -未來只是徒勞
programme.desc: The four friends reach a dead end and, even worse, are caught by the lurking Bruno Black. Bruno gives our heroes a sobering reality check, but Hulk refuses to give up, even when all hope is lost.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -傳說級的鐵扇
programme.desc: Regal Academy faces Shan Academy in a track-and-field competition. Hawk, Travis, and Astoria are beaten by LingLing, Princess IronFan's granddaughter. Rose must find LingLing's weakness: a love of frilly dresses, to save the day.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -黑死病
programme.desc: The Black Plague is running rampant through Europe, leaving death and destruction in its wake! This episode provides a catalog of the effects the plague has on the human body and the various weird and wonderful cures dreamed up by the contemporary medics.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -多奇探險隊的大冒險
programme.desc: While practicing some circus-style tricks, team Doki gets an idea to put on a real circus show for all their friends of the Worldwide Expedition Club. Doki wants it to be amazing, so they set off to a real circus to find out how to put on the Greatest Show on Earth.

programme.title: 太摩和圖拉: 小小廚神 -熱帶風味三明治
programme.desc: Telmo and Tula have fun cooking a simple recipe that everybody will be able to follow: a tropical sandwich.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -艾斯特的一天
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with - especially on her Segway! And when a normal day includes alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods, you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -費城

programme.title: 和格林韋德一家環保生活 -回收紙張
programme.desc: The Grimwades love art, but a shortage of paper stops the activity. Luckily the tree that Dad is planting in the garden gives them an idea. Trees are one way to make paper. Let's go green and find out more.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -小鳥紙風箏
programme.desc: What makes a kite stay in the sky? We'll explain all with this playful paper poultry.

programme.title: 優可 -外太空的石頭
programme.desc: Yoko's magic helps Oto and Vik learn that keeping your mind open to new things can lead to unexpected fun.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -一座橋
programme.desc: Help Pooch get over the gap by building a nice strong bridge! We're here to support you.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -澳洲之旅
programme.desc: Zoe bumps her head on a metal light fitting and is looking for medicine to relieve the pain of the headache. In Australia, some people treat headaches with plants. Our heroes will have to meet William and Japaljarri, and they will be surprised.

programme.title: 小小致富夢想家 -生態館
programme.desc: Searching for some inspiring ideas, the team seals itself in a Cold War-era Mars habitat. But when a serious malfunction occurs, the team must work together to solve it. Meanwhile, Zeke, locked out of the dome, spends a lot of quality time with the family, Max's family.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -耳朵末日
programme.desc: It's poptastic! The doctors put your acoustic reflex to the test with an enormous balloon. And a serious case of snotting awaits the loser of today's Ouchology.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -驚人的神經元
programme.desc: Eric learns that neurons are the brain's tiny building blocks. He does an experiment to show what they are and how they work. He is surprised to learn that giraffes have neurons that are five metres long.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -英雄海馬迴
programme.desc: It's amazing! There's a furry friend in the lab as the doctors reveal how your brain's hippocampus works to create maps so you don't get lost.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -超級降落傘
programme.desc: Eric makes a parachute that will slow down a falling egg just enough so it doesn't get smashed when it hits the ground. But first he experiments to figure out the best parachute size. He discovers that NASA also use parachutes to drop robotic probes on to the moon.

programme.title: 體操新星 -追隨偉大
programme.desc: The trampoline gymnasts are busy training for a new season of competitions, and for a high-flyer Corey, it looks like this season will be his best yet.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -道別時刻來臨
programme.desc: It's the last day at vet school for the Junior Vets. They faced their fears, overcame anxieties, and, most importantly, they helped all sorts of animals, pets, and critters.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -魔術師與隊長
programme.desc: In this episode of Becoming Xtraordinary presented by Bear Grylls, the 'Undisputed King of Magic' Steven Frayne (aka Dynamo) and Olympic gold medallist hockey captain Kate Richardson-Walsh share their insights on success.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -總統與開拓者
programme.desc: In this episode of Bear Grylls' Becoming Xtraordinary, former President of South Africa and Nobel Peace Prize winner President F.W. de Klerk and first Black woman member of the British Government and pioneering British diplomat Valerie Amos share their life lessons.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -嶄新開始
programme.desc: Figure skaters Josh and Kloe must pull out all the stops to impress a royal visitor. There is also another very special person making a return to the rink, and ice dancer Ella has just days to get herself ready for her first-ever solo performance.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -酥脆的水晶
programme.desc: Eric learns that although it can take millions of years to make one crystal, he can make some in just a week with an easy experiment. His new crystals taste good, too.

programme.title: 寵物救援隊 -苦樂參半的一天
programme.desc: Marisa and Beth rush to rescue a Cavalier King Charles Spaniel with an eye injury. Karen makes a house call to check on Bill and Ben.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -注意音符的分數
programme.desc: How can distinct sounds be formed? In this episode we learn about the key role that fractions play in denoting whole, half, and quarter notes. Can Eric compose his own cool song using nothing but fractions.

programme.title: 神秘大探索: 科學DIY -磁鐵
programme.desc: In this episode Steve Spangler demonstrates unusual, practical, and fun ways to use magnets. Can we make putty that eats magnets? And can magnets help us spot rocks from Outer Space on our roofs? In this episode we'll find out.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室: 請在家嘗試 -眼睛
programme.desc: In this episode, Dr Chris and Dr Xand look at eyes, and show you an experiment to find your blind spot.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室: 請在家嘗試 -聽覺
programme.desc: In this episode, Dr Chris and Dr Xand look at hearing, and show you an experiment to see a sound wave in action.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -一隻鳥!一隻魚!是變態
programme.desc: In this episode mathemagician Eric turns a bird turn into a fish! In order to understand his shape- shifting trick, we learn all about Escher's metamorphosis: the illusion of one animal slowly transforming into another, line by line.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -正四面體的樹
programme.desc: In this episode Eric tries to solve an age-old mystery: How should four trees be placed if the distances between them need to be the same? To find an answer, Eric uses three-dimensional objects called ‘tetrahedrons'.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -配對襪子
programme.desc: In this episode we explain the concept of 'probability'. How can we weigh all our possibilities to eventually pick the most likely outcome? In order to illustrate our options, Eric rearranges his messy sock drawer – blindfolded.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -你喝的水夠多嗎
programme.desc: The doctors explain how your urine can tell you if you've drunk enough water. Dr. Chris looks at how snake venom can damage the body. In the emergency room, one patient has banged his head on some railings, and another has a huge black eye.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -丹麥大象
programme.desc: This episode demonstrates how following a specific sequence of arithmetic steps, combined with the special properties of number 9, will always result in the same answer. Amaze your friends with your mind-reading super skills.

programme.title: 體操新星 -只有一人能去
programme.desc: It's the Youth Olympic Games in Argentina, and Amelie has been selected as the only female artistic gymnast to represent Great Britain. Great news for Amelie, but this means she'll be leaving her best friend and training partner - Phoebe - behind.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -動起來
programme.desc: The Junior Vets get sporty, helping horses at a polo match! Magda, the mare, is just back from injury – will she make it through the game? Barnaby, the rabbit, needs surgery, and a Burmese python has the sniffles. Plus, Johnny and Inel meet a naughty, food-stealing dog.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -一隻鳥!一隻魚!是變態
programme.desc: In this episode mathemagician Eric turns a bird turn into a fish! In order to understand his shape- shifting trick, we learn all about Escher's metamorphosis: the illusion of one animal slowly transforming into another, line by line.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -新名字
programme.desc: Can the Junior Vets determine the sex of a very special penguin? Six cute kittens need checkups and new names - meet X-ray, Smudge, and, of course, baby Johnny! And Paul, the rat, has trouble breathing.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -一棵樹有多高
programme.desc: How can we figure out the height of tall objects such as a tree or a basketball net without using a ladder? In this episode we learn how indirect measurements, proportions, and estimation can be used to compute linear measures with surprising accuracy.

西藏·星空下的傳奇
programme.desc: 《星途》循著藏曆節律，講述高原上人與自然的相守與探索。科研者達娃三十年追蹤西藏蝴蝶，在墨脫雨林、吉隆溝等險境中記錄近600種蝶類，用科學解碼生命密碼，更以藏文命名編撰圖鑑.

programme.title: 運動明星又過界
programme.desc: 運動攀登近年從極限運動轉變成戶內及老少鹹宜的運動，並雲集各路攀登高手於奧運場上競技。備受港人關注的長洲搶包山亦是運動攀登中速度賽與難度賽的結合。. 香港足球運動員歐陽耀冲（歐冲）一向在綠茵場上奔跑，這次跟著六屆包山后學習跌、抱石、扭腰移動、跳躍等動作，甚至跟教練比拼速度賽！他能否憑藉運動員不服輸的拼勁贏得首次速度賽.

programme.title: 十二封信
programme.sub-title: 第四集：我想給你一個晴天，但我只有一把烏雲做的傘
programme.desc: 1991年，唐亦尋三兄弟的檯球屋被黑道砸毀，買船錢也被搶走。葉海棠在家遭受父親暴打，為唐亦尋包紮傷口時，兩個傷痕累累的靈魂終於靠近。他們夜守郵筒，發現葉海棠投進去的「遺書」竟憑空返回。2026年，沈程與余念為郵筒的真偽爭執不休，張泉卻在午夜將「遺書」扔進了郵筒，觸發了奇蹟.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 縱貫南北的千里長河，書寫人水共生的中國方案，向北方輸送源源不絕的清泉，背後是百萬「守水人」的誓言；當西溪濕地重現珍稀飛鳥，桃花水母成為水質「晴雨表」，這些工作使我們深切了解，清水源流是文明延續的生命基因.

programme.title: IP 新機遇 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 在創意驅動的市場裡，知識產權是品牌成長背後的重要後盾。香港有一個本地曲奇品牌，由用心的創作者以品質與誠意打動顧客，逐步建立屬於自己的口碑。. 今集將帶大家了解，品牌如何運用商標保障自身形象，守護品牌價值，在激烈競爭中脫穎而出，并且透過持續創新，讓一塊曲奇成為能被記住的故事，延伸出更大的品牌力量.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: Hong Kong is riding a “pet‑friendly” wave. Malls, restaurants, and even public transport are opening to pets, reshaping city life and sparking new economic opportunities. The programme explores pet‑only mall floors, pet‑friendly transit, and expert views on how this trend could transform Hong Kong’s consumer landscape.

programme.title: 香港故事：情繫香港
programme.sub-title: Turkey's Cultural Fusion in Hong Kong
programme.desc: Whether it's the traditional Turkish mosaic lamps or Turkish coffee, they both carry a rich history and culture, serving as a bridge for mutual understanding between Turkish and Hong Kong people. Two Turkish brothers, recognizing the business potential in Hong Kong, opened the first Turkish restaurant and introduced halal food practices.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 在埃塞俄比亞，蜜蜂不僅僅是繁衍與豐饒的象徵，更承載著這個全球第二古老的基督教國家的信仰.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 在墨西哥，蜜蜂奉獻如此之多，以至於該國成為全球蜂蜜生產的領導者。蜜蜂激發了人們的尊敬與欽佩.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 唱作歌手李靖筠(Gladys)近年嘗試R&B慵懶風格，同樣身為唱作人的布志綸(Alan)，作品就揉合搖滾、抒情，風格多變。兩位將同時上《港樂．講樂》的舞台現場演唱最新派台歌，更會一齊大玩遊戲！. 主持. 阮頌陽. 歌曲：. 李靖筠《最好比我更懶》. 布志綸《貼哋.

programme.title: 怒放
programme.desc: 本集將視角從競技賽場延伸至幕後，聚焦默默為運動員逐夢築牢支撐的團體——無私奉獻的志願者、深耕科技助殘的工作者、推進場館無障礙改造的團隊、用心做好輔具服務保障的工作者。他們以責任為帆，以熱愛為槳，用默默堅守與全力付出，成為運動員最堅強的後盾，凸顯責任與熱愛交織的溫暖力量。. 播映時間：2月10日星期二晚上8點.

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第十三集：七連對敵發動猛烈攻勢
programme.desc: 雷公帶炮排沖鋒，萬里展示投彈天賦，用手榴彈炸毀美軍坦克。梅生駕車率七連突破雷區，發起猛烈攻勢，北極熊團潰散。七連炮排遭到美軍的炮火轟擊，迫擊炮支架被炸斷，身受重傷的長喜以身體作為支撐，大壯含淚作戰。漢斯請求反擊未果，上校逃避戰局.

小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第二十二集: 莊超英對孩子發火
programme.desc: 莊超英叫孩子到祖父母家一趟，兩個人都不太願意，找各種藉口推來推去。莊超英非常生氣，一怒之下揮手打了筱婷一巴掌。鵬飛說祖父母曾恐嚇筱婷，說過如果他們學習成績不好，父母就要離婚。林武峰來信了，讓莊圖南和林棟哲一起去廣州，初到廣州，莊圖南目不暇接.

programme.title: 小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第二十三集: 莊圖南畢業後的選擇
programme.desc: 在廣州的林棟哲想起了從小和莊筱婷長大的點點滴滴，十分想念她。林棟哲打電話給筱婷，說決定跟她報同一所大學，莊筱婷聽了也很高興。莊圖南畢業後會分配回蘇州工作，但他想讀研究班。莊超英覺得讀了研也不一定能留在上海，他和黃玲希望莊圖南能找一份安穩的工作.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 本集嘉賓伍經衡，幼時英語成績欠佳，差點兒「考包尾」。然而，老師的一句勉勵之言，卻徹底改變了他的人生軌跡。自此，他投身教育事業，先後任教、創辦補習社，並於退休之年完成博士學位，更榮獲「最佳博士論文獎」。. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 黃仲遠(註冊組織心理學家). 嘉賓：. 伍經衡(補習社創辦人). #補習老師#義教#博士#Richard Eng #學海無涯.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 五位勇敢的英雄正在執行任務，但阿菇掉進了一個神秘的洞穴裡，而洞穴裡的小蘑菇們竟然把他當作國王….

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今集主持人會學習以北海道食材，製作豆沙餡料。豆沙餡的款式包羅萬有，有粒粒豆沙、綿滑豆沙，亦有分紅豆製和白腰豆製的！另外，他們還嘗試製作豆沙包，不知味道如何呢.

programme.title: 長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第三十三集：何有光赴約鴻門宴
programme.desc: 何有光命令將高州封城，魚常侍毫無懼色，約何有光赴約鴻門宴。魚朝恩揭開了何有光的野心，以及背後真正的主人。當年何有光取代海虎到長安，投靠貴人，蟄伏在高州隨時待命.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 藝術無界限，一眾展能藝術家除了表演自己專長的藝術項目，亦在彼此藝術範疇以外作出新嘗試，今次是「做戲」！展能藝術家趙惠芝和李昇，會和主持Angel梁安琪、富爸爸岑幸富分享他們今次的藝術經歷。展能藝術家伍惠娟會和沙畫藝術家胡藹的一同傾下彼此藝術交流的樂趣和故事.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂
programme.desc: 鮮豔的顏色層次、衝擊的味覺體驗，泰菜的魅力席捲亞洲。主廚Art Sinlaparkorn在本集會分享泰國料理中酸、辣、鹹、甜的精妙平衡，以及自己的烹飪哲學。兒時受祖母啟發，令他醉心於泰國料理的藝術，踏上成為廚師之路。Chef Art將從小到大嘗遍的泰國地道風味，直接複製到香港；更邀請主持Andy Dark細嚐青木瓜沙律、醉貓炒河、泰式椰子煎餅等街頭美食。. 離開家鄉追隨夢想，Chef Art幸運地在香港遇上他的「另一半」。他們與一班同鄉好友，慢慢在香港建立另一個「家」.

programme.title: 31 看世界 - 物種大滅絕
programme.desc: 印度住了約27,000隻亞洲象，擁有全世界最大型的亞洲象群落。雖然印度能每日為每隻亞洲象提供450公斤食物，但牠們的存活卻面臨威脅。亞洲象對高溫敏感，炎熱天氣可引發牠們出現代謝症候群、氧化壓力、免疫抑制反應，甚至死亡，而影響繁殖率。目前印度境內有約42%的亞洲象棲息地，因為人為壓力和氣候變化夾擊而消失。. 印度環境、森林及氣候變化部門和一眾動物專家，正努力創建環保通道，協助大象暢通無阻地搬家。我們一於隨著專家和本地居民，去看看這些亞洲象能否在氣候變化威脅之下倖存下來。. India is home to approximately 27,000 Asian Elephants, which is the world’s largest population of the species. The country may be the species’ main stronghold, helping each elephant consume 450 kg of food every day. But its survival is now under threat. . Their sensitivity to heat leads to metabolic disorders, oxidative stress, immune suppression, and death, impacting their reproduction rates. Some 42% of the present available habitat in the country will be lost due to the combined effects of human pressure and climate change. . The elephants are likely to shift towards higher elevations in the Himalayas. We follow animals’ activists along with the Ministry of Environment, Forests and Climate Change in India who are battling to create a green corridor to help them to travel and shift habitats without issue and give legal protection to the movement of elephants. . Can the Asian elephant survive these modern threats to its existence.

programme.title: 西藏·星空下的傳奇
programme.desc: 《星途》循著藏曆節律，講述高原上人與自然的相守與探索。科研者達娃三十年追蹤西藏蝴蝶，在墨脫雨林、吉隆溝等險境中記錄近600種蝶類，用科學解碼生命密碼，更以藏文命名編撰圖鑑.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 五位勇敢的英雄正在執行任務，但阿菇掉進了一個神秘的洞穴裡，而洞穴裡的小蘑菇們竟然把他當作國王….

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今集主持人會學習以北海道食材，製作豆沙餡料。豆沙餡的款式包羅萬有，有粒粒豆沙、綿滑豆沙，亦有分紅豆製和白腰豆製的！另外，他們還嘗試製作豆沙包，不知味道如何呢.

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第十四集：余從戎犧牲伍萬里崩潰
programme.desc: 在新興里的戰鬥中，七連繳獲了北極熊團的團旗，但也付出了慘重的代價，僅剩半個連。余從戎為保護萬里而犧牲，萬里悲痛欲絕。團長命令七連迅速穿越長津湖冰面，佔領死鷹嶺高地，阻擊南下的美軍。五連的大壯堅決要求留在七連報仇.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第二十四集: 林棟哲與莊筱婷再做同學
programme.desc: 莊圖南與李佳畢業聚會就要分開了。林棟哲真的考上了莊筱婷同一所上海的大學，他返回蘇州親自告訴莊筱婷這個好消息。黃玲表示宋瑩要是在的話，一定要敲鑼打鼓昭告天下。向鵬飛高考成績不理想，他母親希望他重讀考大學，求哥哥莊超英繼續收留鵬飛，不過鵬飛已另有打算.

programme.title: 小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第二十五集: 林棟哲嫌莊圖南破壞約會
programme.desc: 林棟哲約了莊筱婷看電影，等了很久都沒有等到她，原來莊圖南來了探妹妹，林棟哲想要讓莊圖南趕緊走。鄰居張阿妹想要住在宋瑩空著的房子，對人說宋瑩把房子租給她，但黃玲覺得宋瑩不可能不告訴自己把房子租出。新政策下林武峰可以回去蘇州的單位了，但林武峰並不願意.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 為進一步推動粵港澳大灣區的文化交融，深圳市前海管理局與香港電台聯合主辦「學人沙龍——影視創新天」深圳前海特別企劃。並邀請兩位在不同階段參與影視製作的監製級人物楊盼盼與林子聰，共同探討深港文化交流與影視產業合作的新機遇。. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 楊盼盼(演員、動作指導、監製). 林子聰(演員、監製). #前海#影視創新天#灣區之眼#文化交流#新機遇.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 赫伯特發明了一頂不實用的「降溫帽子」，卡通動畫有趣兒童輕鬆並遭受謎語大師的嘲笑，然而最後他卻用這頂帽子拯救了世界.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 瀧川市擁有領先日本的油菜種植園區。農民會在露天的田播種，在溫室收割。命名「雪割油菜」的農夫，2009年時曾出演本節目。油菜農民太太煮的菜式相當美味.

programme.desc: 雲清要將趙辛民拉到自己的陣營，她給趙辛民講了一個故事. . . .沒有了雙層甕，荔枝轉運眼看就要失敗，在最後關頭，李善德想到，可以用竹筒存放荔枝.

政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 布志綸(Alan)，前樂隊主唱兼唱作人，作品融入生活體悟，觸動人心。李靖筠(Gladys)，由模特兒轉型做演員，再成為歌手，一直嘗試不同的曲風。兩位唱作歌手一起來到《港樂．講樂》，近距離向樂迷獻唱動人情歌。. 主持. 阮頌陽. 歌曲：. 李靖筠《2+1=1》. 布志綸《如是因如是果.

programme.title: 31看世界 – 維克托的極限清單2
programme.sub-title: 與安達盧西亞牛仔同行
programme.desc: 維克托將會躍上馬背，展開這趟挑戰旅程。他先跟隨馴馬師學習，再前往法蘭琪-康堤寄宿於一個「牛仔之家」，藉此裝備自己，為參與西班牙安達盧西亞歷史悠久的「雌馬出巡」習俗做好準備。. 屆時，維克托會與一眾安達盧西亞傳奇野馬牧人並肩，護送上千匹野生雌馬，從多尼亞納國家公園出發，跨越威爾瓦的廣袤田野，前往阿爾蒙特。這次旅程彷彿穿越時空，帶領觀眾走入一個以馬為尊的世界.

programme.title: 中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第四集 - 黃捷穎、馮皓揚、陳紫萱｜世代流傳建築技術智慧！
programme.desc: 第四集的星級嘉賓是黃捷穎Vinky 、演員馮皓揚和陳紫萱Summer。動靜皆宜的前國家跨欄運動員Vinky，帶來了自己繪畫的龍插畫作品與大家分享。環保、歷史地理、中國近代建設、文學、傳統文化及等等的題目包羅萬有，嘉賓們又能否一一解答？若然畫功好又能否佔盡優勢？一件歷史源遠流長的木製小玩意，居然蘊含中國古代建築技術的大智慧，以三位嘉賓的學識智慧又能否破解，最後成功取得中華知識王的美譽呢？. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 嘉賓：黃捷穎、馮皓揚、陳紫萱. #中華知識王2 #曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#黃捷穎#馮皓揚#陳紫萱#東北長白山#中國建築技術.

programme.title: 濾鏡
programme.sub-title: 第十三集：真假方瑾同時出現
programme.desc: 方謹得知是蘇橙橙用濾鏡手鐲變成自己的樣子幫助了自己，心中感激。方謹成功離婚，並和唐奇的公司成功簽約。唐奇為自己對方謹的情感感到困惑，再次去實驗室找方謹，卡在方謹形象上的蘇橙橙正與方謹在實驗室研究新品的改進。唐奇突然到來，兩個方謹再次機智地嚇住了唐奇.

programme.desc: 維克托將會躍上馬背，展開這趟挑戰旅程。他先跟隨馴馬師學習，再前往法蘭琪-康堤寄宿於一個「牛仔之家」，藉此裝備自己，為參與西班牙安達盧西亞歷史悠久的「雌馬出巡」習俗做好準備。. 屆時，維克托會與一眾安達盧西亞傳奇野馬牧人並肩，護送上千匹野生雌馬，從多尼亞納國家公園出發，跨越威爾瓦的廣袤田野，前往阿爾蒙特。這次旅程彷彿穿越時空，帶領觀眾走入一個以馬為尊的世界.

programme.sub-title: 第二十六集: 姍姍不滿爸爸不讓弟弟上高中
programme.desc: 鄰居老吳的女兒姍姍當年犧牲了自己不報讀高中考大學，現在父母又不讓弟弟小軍上高中。小軍覺得讀技校也不錯，姍姍表示小軍還不明白，林棟哲他們上大學了，姐弟和他們之間的差距越來越大了。有一天，莊圖南見到林棟哲和莊筱婷牽手，非常震驚，沒想到他們居然在一起了.

programme.title: 小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第二十七集: 物價飆升搶購商品
programme.desc: 物價漲得非常快，林武峰讓宋瑩去把錢拿出來買黃金。莊圖南跟教授做醫院的項目，與規劃局的李佳碰面。莊圖南要跟林棟哲和向鵬飛去做生意，莊超英不同意，覺得莊圖南應該好好學習。莊圖南覺得家裡有困難的時候自己沒支持十分內疚，黃玲把家裡的錢交給莊圖南，支持他去做.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今集《小農夫大作物新一彈》主持人會到訪一個育有七子一女的十人大家庭，看看他們如何經營酪農農場。十三年前，夫婦二人從東京來到大樹町，展開務農生活.

programme.title: 長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第三十五集：魚常侍派人殺李善德
programme.desc: 魚常侍派白望入去殺李善德，趕巧被鄭平安撞見了，為了讓李善德帶着袖兒有時間逃離，鄭平安攔下了白望人，卻倒在了血泊中。鄭平安奄奄一息，說自幼膽小，今日能為保護家人勇敢一回。桂花樹宛若盛放，李善德和袖兒究竟能躲過了這一劫嗎.

programme.title: 濾鏡
programme.sub-title: 第十四集：濾鏡手鐲再次升級
programme.desc: 方謹在蘇橙橙等人的鼓勵下，終於自信地在發佈會上介紹了自己的專利。發佈會結束後，唐奇遇見由蘇橙橙變身的方謹，兩人一起看着彩虹，她的一番談話，引得唐奇動情告白，假方謹落荒而逃。此時，濾鏡再次升級完成，蘇橙橙一覺醒來發現自己變身成林媛畫出來的男人全勝唐.

programme.title: 傷健同行小僱事
programme.desc: 作為香港經濟支柱之一的零售業，近年漸見殘疾僱員的身影在其中。在競爭激烈的零售市場當中，不難發現『講金又講心』的溫暖故事。. 售賣咖啡產品的小型連鎖店老闆Gigi，十多年來堅持聘請殘疾人士為員工。. 品牌目前有四間實體店舖，員工人數不多，但其中一半為殘疾人士。當中聾人咖啡師，以及被確診患有專注力不足的烘焙師，除專注在本身的崗位，Gigi近年更安排他們在店舖以及市集擔任銷售員，訓練他們多接觸群眾，練習與人溝通、管理等技巧，帶望他們在能在日後的求職路上更有競爭力。. Gigi更經常鼓勵、安排員工參與本地及國內外的手冲咖啡及烘焙比賽，期望可在小小的咖啡零售店以外，帶領員工踏上更廣闊的舞台，拓闊視野。. 成立二十多年的社企公司，目前有超過七成的員工為精神病康復者。公司旗下業務眾多，零售業為當中主要業務之一，轄下除擁有售賣復康用品的自家品牌店及餐廳，近年更開始跟慈善基金合作，開展便利店的業務。. 曾患思覺失調的康復者，以及患有阿氏保加症的員工，分別擔任便利店店員以及送貨員，其家人、上司、社工等的輔導跟協助，成為他們最強的後盾。. 本集幾位於零售業打拼的殘疾人士，在求職及工作的路上，透過自身努力突破障礙，勇敢挑戰自我.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 細味風情
programme.desc: 巴巴多斯、聖文森特格林納丁斯都是較少人認識的加勒比島嶼，位於南美次大陸附近。它們被稱為「風向群島」，如同頸鏈上的珍珠。當地的原居民是美洲印第安人的後裔，後來，部分與歐洲人及非洲奴隸血統混合。如今，當地人已經掌握悠閒的生活方式.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 縱貫南北的千里長河，書寫人水共生的中國方案，向北方輸送源源不絕的清泉，背後是百萬「守水人」的誓言；當西溪濕地重現珍稀飛鳥，桃花水母成為水質「晴雨表」，這些工作使我們深切了解，清水源流是文明延續的生命基因.

programme.title: IP 新機遇 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 在創意驅動的市場裡，知識產權是品牌成長背後的重要後盾。香港有一個本地曲奇品牌，由用心的創作者以品質與誠意打動顧客，逐步建立屬於自己的口碑。. 今集將帶大家了解，品牌如何運用商標保障自身形象，守護品牌價值，在激烈競爭中脫穎而出，并且透過持續創新，讓一塊曲奇成為能被記住的故事，延伸出更大的品牌力量.

programme.title: 大自然逐樣解4
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解4》邀請了環保協進會創立人及行政總監邱榮光博士，以及環保協進會鳳園蝴蝶保育區項目總監(自然保育)趙玉蓮女士，分享有關香港蝴蝶的生態知識。本集以紅珠鳳蝶、裳鳳蝶、燕鳳蝶作例子，並利用XR擴增實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索不常見蝴蝶的外貌特徵、生活習性、以及生存智慧.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
香港故事：邊境人家
programme.desc: Kuk Po village, located on the remote border between Hong Kong and the Chinese mainland, was once known as a ghost village since the 1970s, when residents moved away for urban life. . Once a vibrant Hakka community with over 500 residents a century ago, Kuk Po village turned into a no man’s land in the 70s, marked by decaying mansions and abandoned ancestral homes. This stark transformation pushed 73-year-old villager Ho Sui Ting to embark on an ambitious project - to revive the empty village. . But it’s a tough job for just one man, but he insists. Ho was the very first batch of villagers to start the project, restoring the vegetation on poor soil and rebuilding the stonewall more than a century ago. He also built a “museum,” collecting artifacts that reflect the Hakka community's collective memories. . “Some people think I’m strange, like the foolish old man (Yugong) in the well-known Chinese fable who moved mountains?,” said Ho. . His works inspired other villagers and even residents from nearby semi-empty islands to join the revival, including Gen Z member Lilian. Lilian did not grow up in the village, but her family has deep roots in Kuk Po. She returned during the COVID pandemic to escape the chaos and started to fall in love with her hometown. She then collaborated with a university to restore her ancestral home, which was built a century ago. . This episode begins with Ho reciting a poem about the journey home, followed by villagers from different generations as they faced the decline of their once-thriving community. How can they revive Kuk Po and restore its spirit and legacy to prevent it from fading into oblivion.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第三十六集：肖春生公司的核心技術被洩漏
programme.desc: 肖春生的女兒肖蓓蓓生日，肖春生邀請葉國華和賀紅玲一起來吃飯。葉國華和賀紅玲回家卻大吵一架，葉國華認為賀紅玲還想著肖春生。面對猜忌懷疑的葉國華，賀紅玲終於忍受不了，她要求離婚。肖春生公司的核心技術被黑子洩漏給李上游。葉國華的公司改而和李上游的公司合作.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第三十七集：肖春生幫葉國華度過難關
programme.desc: 葉國華發現李上游公司的貨品及合同也有問題，肖春生來找葉國華，說他可以為葉國華替換所有的零件，從而達到國際的要求。葉國華非常感動也很愧疚。新年到了，肖豔秋一家子、葉芳和葉國華也來到肖春生家裏拜年，葉芳說賀紅玲要和葉國華離婚，賀紅玲選擇去巴黎進修音樂.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
學人沙龍
programme.desc: 為進一步推動粵港澳大灣區的文化交融，深圳市前海管理局與香港電台聯合主辦「學人沙龍——影視創新天」深圳前海特別企劃。並邀請兩位在不同階段參與影視製作的監製級人物楊盼盼與林子聰，共同探討深港文化交流與影視產業合作的新機遇。. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 楊盼盼(演員、動作指導、監製). 林子聰(演員、監製). #前海#影視創新天#灣區之眼#文化交流#新機遇.

運動明星又過界
programme.desc: 港隊霹靂舞隊不再限於街頭文化，而是直接打進奧運及全運舞台，並於剛過去的全運賽事中取得男子組總排名第五名的驕人成績。. 香港手球隊代表兼物理治療師葉冠英（大英）「捨手取腳」，憑著球場上的爆發力，迎接霹靂舞速度與智慧的考驗。大英跟教練學習搖滾步,排腿,定格等基本動作後即需接受比拼。他能否在短短1分鐘內編出自己的舞步，透過舞步展現自己的故事.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈: 狂喜之詩中國愛樂樂團音樂會
programme.sub-title: 狂喜之詩中國愛樂樂團音樂會
programme.desc: 青年指揮家俞極與國家級交響樂團中國愛樂樂團攜手，呈獻一場精彩的音樂表演。音樂會上，鋼琴演奏家安天旭將擔任獨奏，並細膩地演繹俄羅斯作曲家拉赫瑪尼諾夫的經典作品。音樂會亦會以斯克里亞賓的傑作《狂喜之詩》作為壓軸，將音樂會推向高潮。. . 播放頻道： 港台電視31 播出時間： (首播) 2026年4月25日 星期六 下午3時30分 . Renowned conductor Yu Ji joins forces with the China Philharmonic Orchestra to present a magnificent musical concert. Meanwhile, pianist An Tianxu performs as the soloist and delivering a sensitive performance of Rachmaninoff’s beloved classics. The concert concludes with Alexander Scriabin’s The Poem of Ecstasy—a powerful and exciting finale. . Channel: RTHK 31 Time: (First Run) 2026.04.25 SAT 3:30 pm.

生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 藝術無界限，一眾展能藝術家除了表演自己專長的藝術項目，亦在彼此藝術範疇以外作出新嘗試，今次是「做戲」！展能藝術家趙惠芝和李昇，會和主持Angel梁安琪、富爸爸岑幸富分享他們今次的藝術經歷。展能藝術家伍惠娟會和沙畫藝術家胡藹的一同傾下彼此藝術交流的樂趣和故事.

programme.title: 大自然逐樣解4
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解4》邀請了環保協進會創立人及行政總監邱榮光博士，以及環保協進會鳳園蝴蝶保育區項目總監(自然保育)趙玉蓮女士，分享有關香港蝴蝶的生態知識。本集以紅珠鳳蝶、裳鳳蝶、燕鳳蝶作例子，並利用XR擴增實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索不常見蝴蝶的外貌特徵、生活習性、以及生存智慧.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第五集 - 許靖韻、黎展峯、艾妮｜中華食材詩中尋！
programme.desc: 第五集星級嘉賓許靖韻、黎展峯和艾妮，三位同門師姐弟妹齊齊分享在大江南北遊歷的美好回憶。問答環節不單止有歷史地理、現代文學，想不到還有軍事設備、明朝稅制的難題！今次還會帶大家到訪雲南大理白族周城村，入面世代流傳的傳統技藝你又知多少？中國素來民以食為天，三位嘉賓又能否成功分辨哪些是原產自中國的食材？誰有把握從名詩中找出隱藏其中的食物呢？記得留意今集《中華知識王2》！. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 嘉賓：許靖韻、黎展峯、艾妮. #中華知識王2#曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#許靖韻#黎展峯#艾妮#雲南大理古城#白族周城村#中國原產食材.

programme.title: 十二封信
programme.desc: 1991年，葉海棠和唐亦尋發現「午夜」、「貓咪」、「特殊信紙」是觸發郵筒通信的條件，並用遺書的信紙嘗試回信。2026年，沈程與余念竟真的收到了來自過去的回信，確認了跨時空通信的真實性，決定聯手引導過去的葉海棠。與此同時，那封最初引發風波的「情書」被發現字跡與唐亦尋一模一樣，暗示它可能來自未來的他自己.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
周末大電影：龍的傳人
programme.desc: 周飛鴻(元華飾)是大澳教頭,其子小龍(周星馳飾)與師妹(毛舜筠飾)乃歡喜冤家.某次鴻師弟毛仁(梁家仁飾)到大澳避債.龍知仁古惑,鴻卻托仁帶往市區發展.仁發現龍有桌球天份,遂利用龍賭波賺錢,但連大澳地契亦輸掉,父子山窮水盡.

programme.title: 傷健同行小僱事
programme.desc: 作為香港經濟支柱之一的零售業，近年漸見殘疾僱員的身影在其中。在競爭激烈的零售市場當中，不難發現『講金又講心』的溫暖故事。. 售賣咖啡產品的小型連鎖店老闆Gigi，十多年來堅持聘請殘疾人士為員工。. 品牌目前有四間實體店舖，員工人數不多，但其中一半為殘疾人士。當中聾人咖啡師，以及被確診患有專注力不足的烘焙師，除專注在本身的崗位，Gigi近年更安排他們在店舖以及市集擔任銷售員，訓練他們多接觸群眾，練習與人溝通、管理等技巧，帶望他們在能在日後的求職路上更有競爭力。. Gigi更經常鼓勵、安排員工參與本地及國內外的手冲咖啡及烘焙比賽，期望可在小小的咖啡零售店以外，帶領員工踏上更廣闊的舞台，拓闊視野。. 成立二十多年的社企公司，目前有超過七成的員工為精神病康復者。公司旗下業務眾多，零售業為當中主要業務之一，轄下除擁有售賣復康用品的自家品牌店及餐廳，近年更開始跟慈善基金合作，開展便利店的業務。. 曾患思覺失調的康復者，以及患有阿氏保加症的員工，分別擔任便利店店員以及送貨員，其家人、上司、社工等的輔導跟協助，成為他們最強的後盾。. 本集幾位於零售業打拼的殘疾人士，在求職及工作的路上，透過自身努力突破障礙，勇敢挑戰自我.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂
programme.desc: 鮮豔的顏色層次、衝擊的味覺體驗，泰菜的魅力席捲亞洲。主廚Art Sinlaparkorn在本集會分享泰國料理中酸、辣、鹹、甜的精妙平衡，以及自己的烹飪哲學。兒時受祖母啟發，令他醉心於泰國料理的藝術，踏上成為廚師之路。Chef Art將從小到大嘗遍的泰國地道風味，直接複製到香港；更邀請主持Andy Dark細嚐青木瓜沙律、醉貓炒河、泰式椰子煎餅等街頭美食。. 離開家鄉追隨夢想，Chef Art幸運地在香港遇上他的「另一半」。他們與一班同鄉好友，慢慢在香港建立另一個「家」.

programme.title: 再登地球之巔
programme.desc: 面對極寒、極旱、極缺氧、極強紫外線的大自然，青藏高原上的生命演化出了怎樣獨特的形態？在第二次青藏科考中，科學家搜尋世界級的九大完整垂直自然帶、採集隱密的微生物聚落、探索最俱生物多樣性之一的神秘地帶、追蹤珍稀物種黑頸鶴的遷徙路線。科學家期待揭開青藏高原鮮為人知的「生命之極」.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 你有沒有聽過圓山藥？圓山藥是一種珍貴的農作物，除了池田町之外，北海道很少有地方出產。圓山藥是高級餐廳的食材，也會用來製作日式甜品。大部份會運往關西地區，甚至新加坡售賣.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 灶君和子軒獨留在家，遇到上門盜寶的古董大盜，為了守護家庭財產，灶君子軒與陰險狡詐的古董大盜鬥智斗勇，最終智取古董大盜將他送交警察，子軒和灶君也產生了深厚感情.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 在跳格子大賽中，灶君向土地公求助，意外損壞重力系統，導致小鎮重力異常。子涵憑藉堅韌意志克服重力贏得比賽，最終兩女孩和解，灶君及時恢復重力.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 朝風挑戰菲菲，如福們為菲菲展開魔鬼訓練。挑戰日，菲菲出其不意地智取，未選擇硬碰硬.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 為了防止柿子砸傷行人，胡同街口被路障擋住。如福們決定摘掉柿子，但遭到喜鵲攻擊，原來喜鵲在保護鳥窩.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 在土耳其拉澤人（Lazes）的家園，氣候促使了茂密多樣的植被生長，為蜜蜂提供了理想的生存條件。但蜜蜂並非唯一的受益者；以蜂蜜為食的大型掠食者也相當多.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 在肯尼亞的雅庫人家園，為了保護蜂蜜，人類不得不適應眾多蜜蜂盜竊者的巧妙手段，有時甚至需要與某些掠食者合作，才能收穫蜂蜜.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: Since its establishment in 2022, the Office for Attracting Strategic Enterprises has successfully brought multiple companies to Hong Kong, spanning industries such as artificial intelligence, data science, new energy, and financial technology. What benefits will the arrival of these major enterprises bring to Hong Kong’s capital and employment markets.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
香港故事：情繫香港
programme.desc: In recent years, many Hong Kong people have developed an interest in Arabic. Armma and Amjad, one from Syria and the other from Egypt, both have immigrated to Hong Kong and become respected teachers. In this episode, we will visit these two Arabic teachers to get a glimpse into their lives.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第三十八集：疫症下，佟曉梅發燒了
programme.desc: 最近，醫院出現幾個肺部感染的病症，並具有傳染性，其中一個是春生公司的員工。佟曉梅通知春生讓他隔離公司全部人，肖春生跟從。曉梅接觸過病人，自己也要隔離，肖春生讓她不要大意，要保護好自己。在疫症下，肖春生決定生產口罩。佟曉梅突然暈倒，她發現自己發燒了. . . [全劇完.

programme.title: 公訴
programme.desc: 江城市檢察院和公安局一致決定並選中檢察官安旎率隊，遠赴A國與打入電詐集團的警方卧底張婉茹接頭。原定接頭時間已到，張婉茹卻遲遲未出現，憑藉對她的瞭解，安旎大膽決定繼續等待。安旎終於等到了姍姍來遲的張婉茹，卻也親眼目睹了張婉茹的身亡.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
運動明星又過界
programme.desc: 卡巴迪運動起源於南亞，為刺激版「麻鷹抓雞仔」，需具備力量、敏捷反應和團隊合作精神，香港女子卡巴迪隊蓄勢待發，劍指六月舉辦的第二屆東亞盃女子卡巴迪錦標賽。. 歌手黎展峯（Andy）為跑步愛好者，跟著港隊投入卡巴迪正式訓練，學習步法、捉腳、漁網式防守等主要技巧，最後更與港隊成員來一場正式的卡巴迪比賽！Andy能否展現麻鷹的姿態，捉到最多的雞仔.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：奧菲歐與尤麗迪采
programme.sub-title: 奧菲歐與尤麗迪采 (下集)
programme.desc: 本劇講述奧菲歐痛失愛妻尤麗迪采後，毅然闖入冥界，誓言帶回妻子。愛神賜予他救贖的機會，卻設下「不可回頭」的嚴苛條件。奧菲歐歷經怨靈阻攔、冥界幻景，終與尤麗迪采重逢，卻在返回人間的最後關頭，因妻子的悲傷質疑而絕望回首，導致永別。最終愛神為其深情所動，讓愛人重生，見證真愛超越生死。歌劇片段由香港非凡美樂提供。. 藝術總監：盧景文. 監製及導演：梁笑君. 指揮：杜洛沙. 演出：. 李卓麟. 金雅修. 沈喜詠. 鄧思寧、文浚彥. Rebaroque Orchestra. 非凡美樂合唱團.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：漫興樂想 爵士鋼琴家雷柏熹談即興功夫
programme.sub-title: 漫興樂想 爵士鋼琴家雷柏熹談即興功夫
programme.desc: 爵士樂與功夫，看似沒有關連，其實只不過藝術以不同型式的展現，而「即興」將兩者連繫起來。爵士樂講求樂手之間的互動即興，以音樂建構對話；武術則需要配合時機，身體與本能即興發揮，在實戰中與對手見招拆招。. 《演藝盛薈.開放舞台》搜羅了港大繆思樂季「漫興樂想」系列，以功夫為主題，由鋼琴家雷柏熹，聯同一眾樂手，合奏改編自李小龍經典功夫電影的爵士樂組曲。雷柏熹更邀請兩位武術大師，荷里活武術指導、印尼武術大師戴志良及葉問詠春傳人楊永勣，一同分享爵士樂與武術格鬥的兩者的共通之處：即興，暢談箇中玄機。三位亦會即場獻技，展現爵士樂與武術的哲學和真功夫。節目片段由港大繆思樂季攝製及提供。. 音樂. Patrick Lui 雷柏熹, piano & host. Nate Wong 黃彥康, drums. Wong Tak Chung 黃德聰, bass. Paulo Levi 利保羅, tenor saxophone. Hwasung Yoon, trumpet. Tomomi Taniguchi 谷口知巳, trombone. 功夫. Evan Tai 戴志良, Silat. Jerry Yeung 楊永勣, Ving Tsun.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: 今集講述有一位小鄰居覺得爸爸媽媽，甚至連婆婆都不疼愛她。因為媽媽不給零用錢，婆婆也不理她，感到失去原有的「福利」。到底「福利」是不是應該永遠不變呢？. 所以，貓頭鷹博士登場，引用《基本法》第一百四十五條，帶領芊穎重新思考。究竟這次是父母真的不再疼愛她，還是一場誤會？. 《基本法》第一百四十五條:. 香港特別行政區政府在原有社會福利制度的基礎上，根據經濟條件和社會需要，自行制定其發展、改進的政策。. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 從黃海之濱的「海上牧場」到南海沿線的「海上森林」。從「東方天鵝王國」到海南的綠肺新生。這些都見證生態重煥生機。大天鵝重返榮成海灣，白鷺定居陵水紅樹林，這些大自然的歸客見證生態重生。海上森林築起生態屏障，海洋牧場變身綠色糧倉。當珊瑚、海草、紅樹林在此交會，大自然正為中國的海灣治理頒發藍色勳章.

programme.title: IP 新機遇 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 一個以瀕危動物為靈感的香港原創手袋品牌，憑着生動造型與實用設計，逐步走向國際市場。人氣提升的同時，品牌亦面對山寨產品湧現，影響銷售及品牌形象。. 本集將了解品牌如何透過外觀設計註冊，守護創意成果；又如何憑藉法律保障，維持產品獨特性，讓更多原創動物造型手袋得以安心誕生，繼續在世界各地展現香港設計的魅力.

programme.title: 西藏·星空下的傳奇
programme.desc: 《星願》以星辰為見證，講述高原上文化守護與文明追溯的故事。芒康鹽井，格松江措一家依藏曆守千年鹽田，老房變家庭博物館，讓古法製鹽活態傳承。古格王朝遺址，宗同昌為攝影集重返，與守護十年的巴次共探王朝興衰.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
十二封信
programme.desc: 1991年，二人追查神秘老人和郵筒的來歷。唐亦尋從想將葉海棠關進精神病院的父親手中救出她，兩個孤兒決定結為家人，共同生活。9月23日，信中預言的「龍吸水」異象成真，他們徹底相信了未來通信。2026年，余念因尋父失敗而崩潰大哭，沈程卻在此時接到通知：他的母親葉海棠找到了.

programme.desc: 故事講述王繼才在開山島上守島衛國32年的感人事跡.
